companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
Join us at Accor, where life pulses with passion!

As a pioneer in the art of responsible hospitality, the Accor Group gathers more than 45 brands, 5,600 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and lifestyle destinations in 110 countries. While each brand has its own personality, where you will be able to truly find yourself, they all share a common ambition: to keep innovating and challenging the status-quo.

By joining us, you will become a Heartist®, because hospitality is, first and foremost, a work of heart.

You will join a caring environment and a team where you can be all you are. You will be in a supportive place to grow, to fulfil yourself, to discover other professions and to pursue career opportunities, in your hotel or in other hospitality environments, in your country or anywhere in the world!

You will enjoy exclusive benefits, specific to the sector and beyond, as well as strong recognition for your daily commitment.

Everything you will do with us, regardless of your profession, will offer a deep sense of meaning, to create lasting, memorable and impactful experiences for your customers, for your colleagues and for the planet.

Hospitality is a work of heart,

Join us and become a Heartist®.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Fairmont The Red Sea is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Cost Controller to join our finance team in Umluj, Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and controlling costs across various departments, ensuring accurate financial reporting, and identifying opportunities for cost optimization. You will work closely with departmental managers and senior finance leadership to maintain financial integrity and support strategic decision-making through comprehensive cost analysis and reporting.

  • Monitor and analyze departmental costs and expenditures to identify variances and trends
  • Prepare and maintain detailed cost budgets and forecasts for assigned departments
  • Conduct variance analysis and provide explanations for budget deviations to management
  • Reconcile cost accounts and ensure accuracy of financial records and reports
  • Develop and implement cost control procedures and best practices across departments
  • Generate regular cost reports and financial statements for internal stakeholders
  • Collaborate with department heads to develop cost reduction initiatives and efficiency improvements
  • Maintain compliance with company financial policies and accounting standards
  • Analyze operational data to support pricing strategies and profitability assessments
  • Assist in the preparation of annual budgets and financial projections
  • Investigate cost anomalies and recommend corrective actions
  • Utilize accounting software and ERP systems to track and report on costs

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• 3-5 years of professional experience in cost accounting, financial control, or a related finance role
  • Proven experience managing departmental costs and budgets in a hospitality or similar service industry environment
  • Strong proficiency in financial analysis and cost accounting principles
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and experience with accounting software or ERP systems
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to work with complex financial data
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret financial information
  • Demonstrated ability to prepare accurate financial reports and documentation
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present financial information to non-financial stakeholders
  • Proficiency in variance analysis and forecasting methodologies
  • Experience with process improvement and cost optimization initiatives
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment
  • Knowledge of hospitality industry financial operations (preferred)
  • Experience with SAP or similar enterprise resource planning systems (preferred)

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Account Director – GCC at Faena The Red Sea is responsible for developing and managing high-value business across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), with a primary focus on luxury leisure, groups, and corporate segments. The role will build strong relationships with luxury travel advisors, tour operators, DMCs, corporate accounts, family offices, event planners, and other key commercial partners across priority GCC markets.

This role plays a critical part in positioning Faena The Red Sea as the preferred ultra-luxury Red Sea destination for affluent GCC travelers, family and multigenerational stays, private celebrations, leisure groups, corporate retreats, executive travel, and high-value meetings and events. The position requires deep knowledge of GCC source markets, strong commercial relationships, and an ability to translate the distinctive Faena experience into compelling business opportunities.

As a senior commercial ambassador, the Account Director will drive revenue opportunities across suites, villas, dining, wellness, experiences, meetings, events, and exclusive buyouts while ensuring every engagement reflects the prestige and artistry of the Faena brand. The role works closely with Sales, Events, Marketing, Revenue Management, Reservations, Operations, and other stakeholders to convert demand, maximize account production, and deliver highly personalized guest and partner experiences.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

· Develop and execute a strategic sales plan for priority GCC markets, driving production across luxury leisure, groups, and corporate segments.

· Build and maintain strong relationships with luxury travel advisors, tour operators, DMCs, corporate travel buyers, family offices, event planners, and other key intermediaries across the GCC.

· Identify and secure opportunities for high-end FIT and family leisure travel, private celebrations, leisure groups, corporate retreats, executive stays, meetings, incentives, and exclusive buyouts.

· Position Faena The Red Sea as a preferred ultra-luxury destination for GCC travelers and organizations seeking privacy, distinctive experiences, and exceptional service.

· Manage a portfolio of high-value GCC accounts with clear revenue targets, account strategies, annual production goals, and measurable conversion objectives.

· Develop new accounts and grow existing partnerships through regular sales calls, presentations, market visits, client entertainment, site inspections, and curated familiarization trips.

· Lead negotiations for preferred agreements, corporate rates, group opportunities, and strategic partnerships in line with the hotel’s commercial and revenue objectives.

· Work closely with Events and Operations teams to convert and execute group, meeting, retreat, and celebration business while ensuring a seamless client and guest experience.

· Partner with Marketing to identify GCC-specific campaigns, partnerships, trade activations, and market opportunities that strengthen awareness and generate qualified demand.

· Collaborate with Revenue Management to optimize pricing, availability, need periods, and commercial offers across leisure, corporate, and group opportunities.

· Maintain accurate account plans, sales activities, pipelines, call reports, and opportunity tracking within CRM systems, ensuring timely follow-up and forecasting.

· Monitor GCC travel trends, school and public holiday calendars, corporate activity, major events, competitor developments, and market intelligence relevant to demand generation.

· Represent Faena The Red Sea at key GCC trade shows, roadshows, sales missions, networking events, and client functions as required.

· Coordinate closely with Reservations and the wider Commercial team to ensure high-value enquiries are handled promptly, accurately, and with a strong focus on conversion.

· Uphold the highest standards of luxury selling, relationship management, professionalism, and Faena brand representation at all times.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
QUALIFICATIONS DESIRED

· Minimum 5+ years of experience in luxury hospitality sales, with strong exposure to GCC leisure, groups, and/or corporate segments.

· Established network of luxury travel advisors, tour operators, DMCs, corporate accounts, family offices, event planners, or other relevant partners across GCC markets strongly preferred.

· Previous experience with ultra-luxury hotels, resorts, destination properties, or high-end travel brands is highly desirable.

· Strong understanding of GCC travel behavior, luxury leisure distribution, corporate account management, group sales, and relationship-led commercial development.

· Proven track record of developing accounts, converting high-value business, and achieving or exceeding revenue targets.

· Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

· Ability and willingness to travel frequently across GCC markets and represent the hotel at trade and client events.

· Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen, market awareness, and a proactive approach to business development.

· Fluency in English is mandatory; Arabic is highly desirable.

· Proficient in Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and hotel sales/commercial platforms.

· Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality, Tourism, Marketing, or a related field preferred.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
SKILLS

· Strategic thinker with a hands-on, collaborative approach to account development and market activation.

· Results-driven with a focus on measurable revenue outcomes, account production, and market share growth.

· Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

· Strong analytical, forecasting, pipeline management, and commercial planning capabilities.

· Entrepreneurial mindset with deep knowledge of GCC luxury travel and hospitality markets.

· Proven luxury selling skills, excellent oral and written communication, and exceptional 5-star customer service skills.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The F&B Host/Hostess serves as the first point of contact and the "face" of the hotel’s dining outlets. This role is responsible for warmly welcoming guests, managing reservations, efficiently coordinating seating arrangements, and ensuring a seamless, premium first impression that aligns with Mövenpick’s renowned standards of hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guest Welcome & Seating Management

  • Greet guests warmly and professionally upon arrival with a genuine smile, using their names whenever possible (especially for Accor Live Limitless/ALL members and VIPs).

  • Escort guests to their designated tables, present menus, introduce their server, and ensure they are comfortably seated.

  • Manage the flow of the restaurant floor efficiently, balancing table distributions among service staff to prevent bottlenecks.

  • Extend a gracious and polite farewell to guests as they leave, ensuring their feedback is positive.

2. Reservations & System Administration

  • Handle all incoming dining inquiries, bookings, and walk-ins utilizing the restaurant management system (e.g., TableCheck, OpenTable, or SevenRooms).

  • Optimize seating capacity by strategically planning table allocations for breakfasts, lunches, theme nights, and special events.

  • Maintain an updated guest history database, noting specific dietary preferences, seating requests, allergies, and special occasions (birthdays, anniversaries).

3. Operational Support & Communication

  • Maintain a pristine, organized, and elegant reception desk/host station at all times.

  • Collaborate closely with the service and kitchen teams to communicate table changes, special guest requests, VIP arrivals, or dietary restrictions.

  • Assist the service team during peak operational hours by helping clear tables, presenting bills, or resetting tables if required.

  • Stay thoroughly informed about daily specials, menu ingredients, hotel promotions, and operating hours across all hotel facilities.

4. Professional Etiquette & Brand Compliance

  • Adhere strictly to Mövenpick grooming, uniform, and presentation standards.

  • Handle guest complaints or wait-time frustrations diplomatically and professionally, escalating issues to the Restaurant Manager when necessary.

  • Support hotel localization goals (Saudization) by embodying authentic local hospitality and fostering a welcoming cultural environment.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in a host/hostess or guest-facing role within a 5-star hotel, luxury restaurant, or high-end lounge.

  • Language: Excellent command of English (spoken and written) is required. Fluency in Arabic is highly advantageous to effectively communicate with local corporate clients and families.

  • Technical Skills: Familiarity with modern restaurant reservation platforms and Point of Sale (POS) systems (e.g., Micros Symphony).

  • Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, high emotional intelligence, a vibrant personality, and the ability to remain calm and elegant under pressure.

  • Flexibility: Willingness to work flexible shifts, including weekends, holidays, and split shifts according to business needs.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, we don’t just operate restaurants — we create vibrant destinations where exceptional food, bold energy, and unforgettable experiences come together. As Outlet Manager, you will be the driving force behind the venue’s operational success, guest experience, and team performance, bringing the distinctive SLS spirit to life every day.

Leading from the floor, you will oversee the day-to-day operation of one of our signature venues, inspiring a high-performing team while ensuring exceptional service, operational excellence, and commercial performance. Working closely with F&B leadership and key hotel departments, you will shape memorable dining experiences, drive profitability, and continuously evolve the outlet to remain fresh, relevant, and unmistakably SLS.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the outlet team in delivering consistently elevated, engaging, and dynamic guest experiences in line with SLS brand standards and service philosophy.
  • Act as the face of the outlet, maintaining a strong presence during service and building meaningful relationships with guests, regular patrons, and VIPs.
  • Handle guest feedback and concerns effectively, turning service challenges into opportunities to exceed expectations.
  • Oversee all daily restaurant operations, ensuring seamless coordination across the floor, bar, and supporting areas.
  • Maintain exceptional standards of outlet ambiance, service delivery, product presentation, cleanliness, hygiene, and operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Housekeeping, and other hotel departments to maintain the venue to luxury lifestyle standards.
  • Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of supervisors, waitstaff, hosts, bartenders, and other outlet colleagues.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management, employee engagement, and development of the outlet team.
  • Ensure team members are fully trained in service standards, menu and product knowledge, guest interaction, and compliance requirements.
  • Plan staffing levels, schedules, and team allocation in line with business demand, operational requirements, and budget targets.
  • Drive revenue performance through effective upselling, menu engineering, seat utilization, and other commercial opportunities.
  • Manage operational costs through effective inventory control, ordering, labor scheduling, and wastage management.
  • Monitor sales, labor costs, cost of goods, and other key performance indicators, ensuring accurate reporting and alignment with departmental budgets.
  • Support annual business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and ongoing performance reviews.
  • Partner with Marketing to activate promotional events, seasonal concepts, and brand campaigns that increase outlet awareness and guest traffic.
  • Build relationships with hotel concierges, external partners, and local tastemakers to strengthen the outlet’s visibility and guest flow.
  • Identify and support in-outlet events, private dining experiences, themed activations, sponsorships, product placements, and other revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activity to support the continued evolution and positioning of the venue.
  • Drive creative initiatives that elevate the dining experience, strengthen profitability, and connect with the SLS guest lifestyle.
  • Stay current with emerging trends across dining, mixology, and experiential hospitality to maintain the outlet’s competitive edge.
  • Ensure full compliance with health, safety, hygiene, company policies, and applicable local regulations.

jobDescription.title: Job Description

As Director of Revenue at Faena The Red Sea, you will be pivotal in driving strategic revenue management initiatives across the portfolio. Your insights and leadership will directly influence demand optimization, pricing strategies, and financial performance, helping us deliver on our promise of exceptional luxury and guest experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and support Faena Hotels by analyzing group and transient business trends over a five-year horizon, ensuring measurable improvements in demand, availability, and revenue.
  • Deliver critical, data-driven analysis on short-term revenue impacts, influencing occupancy, average daily rate (ADR), and overall rooms profitability within the 53-week operational period.
  • Engage actively in daily revenue meetings, sales strategy sessions, and property visits to ensure alignment and agile response to market conditions.
  • Analyze STAR Reports and RevPAR index changes, applying insights to forecast trends and guide revenue strategies.
  • Develop and share revenue management best practices that enhance portfolio-wide performance.
  • Stay attuned to industry, market, and economic trends, communicating findings to leadership and guidance teams.
  • Partner with marketing to drive demand during low periods through targeted campaigns and strategic offers that boost bookings and revenue.
  • Lead monthly forecast reviews with a goal of maintaining forecast accuracy within ±5% across all properties.
  • Support the annual operating plan and develop an annual revenue management strategy aligned with Faena’s vision.
  • Cultivate relationships with brand partners, ownership, third-party online travel agencies, and industry groups like HSMAI and local educational institutions.
  • Support high-level displacement analysis and revenue decisions for group business, including extended stays.
  • Guide the annual RFP process with strategic insights and oversight.
  • Train sales and front office teams on revenue management principles and tools, empowering them to maximize revenue potential.
  • Champion the effective use of revenue management technology across all properties and brands within the portfolio.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Proven experience (minimum 7–10 years) in Revenue Management within luxury or lifestyle hospitality brands, preferably managing multi-property portfolios.
  • Strong expertise in forecasting, pricing strategies, and demand management to maximize RevPAR and overall revenue performance.
  • Proficient in revenue management systems such as IDeaS, Duetto, or similar platforms, along with hotel PMS and CRM tools.
  • Data-driven mindset, with the ability to analyze STAR reports, market trends, and financial data to inform strategic decisions and revenue plans.
  • Collaborative team player with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and operations teams.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, with experience training and mentoring teams to enhance revenue management knowledge and capabilities.
  • Deep understanding of market dynamics in the Middle East and Saudi Arabia is highly desirable.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and strategic thinking skills, with attention to detail and a results-oriented approach.
  • Knowledge of hospitality industry standards, brand positioning, and guest experience excellence.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, our youngest guests deserve experiences just as memorable as everyone else. As a Kids Club Animator, you will bring energy, creativity, and fun to every activity while creating a safe and welcoming environment where children can play, explore, and make unforgettable holiday memories.

Working closely with the Kids Club team, you will lead engaging activities, connect naturally with children and families, and bring the playful spirit of SLS to every game, craft, story, and special moment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the daily operation of the Kids Club and ensure children are engaged, entertained, and supervised at all times.
  • Welcome children and their families warmly and introduce them to Kids Club activities and programs.
  • Lead and participate in activities such as arts & crafts, games, storytelling, music, movement, and creative play.
  • Create fun and engaging experiences suited to different ages, group sizes, and interests.
  • Support themed events, seasonal programs, celebrations, and special Kids Club activities.
  • Prepare activity areas and ensure materials, toys, and equipment are ready before each session.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, organized, and welcoming Kids Club environment.
  • Follow child check-in and check-out procedures and ensure children are released only to authorized guardians.
  • Remain attentive to allergies, special requirements, and individual needs and communicate them appropriately.
  • Follow all health, safety, hygiene, and child safeguarding procedures.
  • Work closely with the Kids Club Supervisor and team to ensure smooth daily operations.
  • Contribute creative ideas for new games, activities, and memorable experiences for young guests.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Previous experience in childcare, recreation, education, hospitality, entertainment, or a similar role involving children is preferred.
  • Experience within a hotel, resort, Kids Club, school, nursery, or organized recreational environment is an advantage.
  • Naturally friendly, energetic, patient, and comfortable engaging with children.
  • Creative and confident in leading games, activities, and group entertainment.
  • Strong awareness of child safety with the ability to balance fun and responsibility.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Fluent English communication skills are required.
  • First Aid and Child CPR certification is preferred, or willingness to obtain it as required.
  • Organized, responsible, and able to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexible and able to maintain positive energy in a fast-paced resort environment.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, great food is built on creativity, precision, and a kitchen team that moves as one. As a Sous Chef, you will play a key role in leading the day-to-day culinary operation, supporting the Chef de Cuisine in delivering distinctive, high-quality cuisine that reflects the personality and standards of SLS.

As a hands-on culinary leader, you will guide the team through preparation and service, maintain consistency and quality, and help create memorable dining experiences while keeping the kitchen efficient, organized, and ready for every service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the Chef de Cuisine in the daily management and operation of the kitchen.
  • Assist in executing creative menus aligned with the outlet concept, seasonality, and SLS culinary standards.
  • Ensure consistent standards of food preparation, taste, presentation, and portioning across all kitchen sections.
  • Lead and supervise the culinary team during preparation and service to ensure smooth workflow and timely execution.
  • Oversee mise en place and daily kitchen readiness across assigned sections.
  • Train, coach, and support junior chefs while promoting a positive and performance-driven kitchen culture.
  • Support team scheduling, performance feedback, and development.
  • Monitor food costs, stock levels, portion control, and waste to support operational and budget targets.
  • Oversee ordering, inventory, storage, labeling, and stock rotation procedures.
  • Ensure kitchen equipment is properly maintained and report maintenance requirements when needed.
  • Maintain strict compliance with HACCP, food safety, hygiene, and local health regulations.
  • Conduct regular checks of kitchen stations, storage areas, and overall cleanliness.
  • Coordinate closely with front-of-house teams to ensure smooth service and a consistent guest experience.
  • Manage dietary requirements, allergies, VIP requests, and special arrangements with accuracy and care.
  • Take responsibility for kitchen operations in the absence of the Chef de Cuisine when required.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Degree or diploma in Culinary Arts or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum 7 years of professional culinary experience, including at least 3 years in a supervisory or leadership role, preferably within a luxury hotel, resort, or upscale restaurant.
  • Previous experience as a Junior Sous Chef, Chef de Partie, or similar culinary leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of modern cooking techniques, ingredients, kitchen operations, and culinary standards.
  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop a culinary team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Good knowledge of food cost control, inventory management, portion control, and waste management.
  • Strong understanding of HACCP, food safety, and hygiene standards.
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills with a hands-on leadership approach.
  • Passion for culinary creativity, quality, and delivering memorable guest experiences.
  • Flexible and able to perform effectively in a fast-paced luxury hospitality environment.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, every detail matters — including how our team looks and feels. As a Uniform Attendant, you will help ensure our team members are always ready to represent SLS at their best by keeping uniforms organized, well-presented, and available when needed.

Working closely with Laundry and Housekeeping, you will manage the daily distribution, collection, organization, and care of team member uniforms while maintaining accurate records and a smooth uniform operation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Distribute clean and well-presented uniforms to team members.
  • Receive, sort, and inspect used uniforms before processing.
  • Prepare, label, assign, and issue uniforms for new team members.
  • Support uniform fittings, exchanges, and replacement requests.
  • Maintain accurate records of uniform issuance, returns, and assignments.
  • Organize uniforms by department, team member, and identification number.
  • Monitor uniform inventory and report shortages, damages, or replacement requirements.
  • Coordinate uniform cleaning, pressing, repairs, and alterations as required.
  • Support regular uniform inventory counts and maintain appropriate stock levels.
  • Assist team members professionally with uniform-related requests.
  • Maintain the uniform room in a clean, organized, and safe condition.
  • Coordinate closely with Laundry and Housekeeping to ensure smooth daily operations.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• High school diploma or equivalent is preferred.
  • Previous experience in a uniform room, laundry, housekeeping, or similar hospitality role is preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of garment care and uniform handling is an advantage.
  • Good organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Basic understanding of inventory and stock control.
  • Good communication skills and basic English proficiency.
  • Reliable, flexible, and comfortable working in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, exceptional stays begin with the details guests may never notice — because everything simply feels right. As a Housekeeping Supervisor, you will help ensure our guest rooms and public areas are consistently presented to the highest standards of cleanliness, comfort, and readiness.

You will support the daily housekeeping operation, guide the team on the floor, inspect rooms, and work closely with other resort departments to deliver a seamless guest experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily housekeeping operations across assigned floors and areas.
  • Assign and follow up on daily tasks for the housekeeping team.
  • Inspect guest rooms and public areas to ensure SLS cleanliness and presentation standards are maintained.
  • Monitor arrivals, departures, VIPs, and special guest requirements.
  • Support the team with daily briefings, coaching, and on-the-job training.
  • Respond to guest requests and ensure proper follow-up.
  • Coordinate with Front Office, Engineering, Laundry, and other resort departments.
  • Monitor housekeeping supplies, amenities, linen, equipment, pantries, and trolleys.
  • Ensure safety, lost and found, key control, and housekeeping procedures are followed.
  • Support scheduling, attendance tracking, and daily operational reporting.
  • Lead by example and maintain SLS grooming, service, and professional standards.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Diploma or qualification in Hospitality, Tourism, Hotel Management, or a related field is preferred.
  • Previous experience in Housekeeping or hotel operations, preferably within a luxury hotel or resort environment.
  • Supervisory or team-leading experience is preferred.
  • Good understanding of housekeeping standards, room inspections, and daily hotel operations.
  • Strong attention to detail and good organizational skills.
  • Confident communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to guide and support a team.
  • Good English communication skills.
  • Basic proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; OPERA PMS knowledge is preferred.
  • Proactive, flexible, and comfortable working in a fast-paced resort environment.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At FAENA The Red Sea, we are dedicated to creating transformative wellness experiences that inspire balance, vitality, and personal growth. We are currently seeking an experienced and passionate Personal Trainer to join our wellness team. This role is responsible for delivering personalised fitness sessions, including personal training, Tai Chi, and EMS technology-based training, while ensuring guests receive exceptional service and professional guidance in line with FAENA’s luxury wellness and Forbes service standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive client assessments to evaluate fitness levels, goals, and physical limitations.
  • Design and deliver personalised fitness and wellness programmes tailored to individual guest needs.
  • Lead personal training sessions, including Tai Chi and EMS training, ensuring safe and effective exercise techniques.
  • Monitor client performance and progress, adapting programmes where required to maximise results.
  • Provide ongoing motivation, coaching, and support to encourage client engagement and retention.
  • Educate guests on fitness techniques, posture, movement, and overall wellness principles.
  • Ensure all training sessions are delivered with professionalism, energy, and exceptional guest care.
  • Maintain accurate client records, progress tracking, and session documentation.
  • Ensure fitness equipment, studio areas, and wellness spaces are clean, organised, and properly maintained.
  • Follow all health, safety, hygiene, and operational procedures at all times.
  • Collaborate closely with the wellness and spa team to enhance the overall guest experience.
  • Support wellness initiatives, special programmes, and guest engagement activities when required.
  • Uphold FAENA grooming, presentation, and luxury service standards at all times.
  • Ensure full compliance with Forbes standards, maintaining exceptional service quality, professionalism, and operational excellence at all times.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Certified Personal Trainer qualification required.
  • Additional certifications in Tai Chi, EMS training, or wellness coaching are highly advantageous.
  • Previous experience within a luxury hotel, wellness resort, spa, or premium fitness environment preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of exercise science, fitness programming, and injury prevention techniques.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to motivate and inspire clients.
  • Passion for health, wellness, and delivering personalised guest experiences.
  • Ability to adapt training methods to suit varying fitness levels and guest requirements.
  • Professional appearance and presentation aligned with luxury hospitality standards.
  • Experience working within a Forbes standard hotel or luxury wellness environment is highly advantageous.
  • Fluent English communication skills required; additional languages are considered an advantage.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Barista is responsible for delivering an exceptional guest experience through the preparation and service of high-quality non-alcoholic beverages. This role focuses on consistency, presentation, service excellence, and operational standards while creating a welcoming and engaging atmosphere that reflects the brand’s service culture.

  • Prepare and serve non-alcoholic beverages according to standard recipes
  • Ensure consistent quality, presentation, and portion control of all drinks
  • Provide friendly, attentive, and professional service to all guests
  • Maintain a welcoming atmosphere at the bar and ensure guest satisfaction
  • Handle guest complaints or special requests politely and efficiently
  • Set up and close the bar according to standard operating procedures (SOPs)
  • Maintain cleanliness and hygiene of bar counters, equipment, and utensils
  • Ensure proper stock rotation and storage of all beverages and garnishes
  • Record sales accurately and handle cash, credit cards, or room charges responsibly
  • Report shortages, breakages, or discrepancies to management
  • Adhere to local laws and company safety regulations
  • Follow all hygiene, sanitation, and food safety standards
  • Coordinate with waitstaff and kitchen for smooth service
  • Attend daily briefings and participate in staff training sessions
  • Support colleagues during peak hours to maintain efficiency

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Proven experience in the beverage department with prior experience in a high-end beach club or a luxury hospitality environment.
  • Deep knowledge of the restaurant’s specialized beverage menu, including a detailed understanding of ingredients, preparation methods, or drink pairings.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and assist guests with confidence and professionalism.
  • Ability to memorize and explain menu items in detail, providing guests with an educational and enriching dining experience.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Strong customer service skills and a passion for delivering high-quality experience

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We are seeking a skilled and compassionate Spa Therapist to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. As a Spa Therapist, you will play a crucial role in providing exceptional spa services and ensuring our clients have a relaxing and rejuvenating experience. Your expertise and dedication will contribute to creating a serene and welcoming atmosphere for our guests.

  • Deliver a wide range of spa services, including body treatments and massages, in a safe and comfortable manner
  • Maintain a clean, hygienic, and well-stocked treatment room
  • Conduct thorough consultations with clients to understand their needs and preferences
  • Customize treatments to address individual client concerns and goals
  • Educate clients on proper skincare routines and recommend appropriate products
  • Maintain accurate client records and treatment documentation
  • Adhere to all health and safety regulations and hygiene standards
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure smooth spa operations
  • Stay updated on the latest spa trends and techniques
  • Contribute to creating a positive and relaxing environment for all guests

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Proven work experience as a Spa Therapist
  • Certification in massage therapy or related field
  • Hands-on experience in various massage techniques and face/body therapies
  • In-depth knowledge of anatomy and physiology
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Good command of English; knowledge of Arabic is a plus
  • Positive attitude and empathetic nature
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on cleanliness and organization
  • Comprehensive knowledge of various spa treatments and products
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new techniques and treatments
  • Physical stamina to perform treatments throughout the day
  • Flexibility to work varying shifts, including weekends and holidays
  • Familiarity with local cultural norms and customs in Saudi Arabia
  • Ability to maintain a calm and professional demeanor in all situations

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
Your Team and Working Environment:

Join our warm and welcoming team as a Spa Therapist, where expertise, empathy, and guest well-being are at the heart of everything we do. In this hands-on and client-focused role, you’ll be part of a professional team dedicated to providing relaxing, rejuvenating, and personalized spa experiences. Surrounded by passionate colleagues who value teamwork and excellence, you'll play a vital role in enhancing the overall guest journey—one treatment at a time.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Graphic Designer is responsible for creating and developing high-quality visual content that supports the hotel’s marketing, branding, promotional, and communication activities. The role ensures all creative materials are aligned with the hotel’s brand identity, visual standards, and marketing objectives across digital and print platforms.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop creative concepts and visual designs for marketing campaigns, promotions, events, and hotel communications.
* Design digital and print materials including brochures, flyers, posters, menus, advertisements, presentations, social media content, and promotional materials.
* Create engaging visual content for the hotel’s website, social media platforms, email campaigns, and other digital channels.
* Ensure all designs are consistent with the hotel’s brand identity, guidelines, and visual standards.
* Collaborate with the Marketing, Sales, E-Commerce, and Operations teams to understand creative requirements and deliver effective visual solutions.
* Support the development of promotional campaigns for restaurants, rooms, events, seasonal offers, and special occasions.
* Prepare artwork and files according to technical specifications for printing and digital publishing.
* Coordinate with external printers, photographers, agencies, and other creative suppliers when required.
* Maintain an organized library of design assets, images, templates, and brand materials.
* Retouch and edit photographs and other visual materials when required.
* Stay updated on current design trends, digital content formats, and creative industry best practices.
* Manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining high standards of quality and attention to detail.
* Ensure all published content is accurate, professional, and aligned with the hotel’s positioning.
* Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by management

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of professional experience as a Graphic Designer, preferably within the hospitality, tourism, retail, or marketing industry.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
  • Experience creating content for social media and digital marketing platforms.
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, color, branding, and visual communication.
  • Creative mindset with strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively under tight deadlines.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of motion graphics, video editing, or photography is an advantage.
  • Saudi Nationality is required.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Responsible for supporting and executing the hotel’s marketing, e-commerce, and distribution strategies to maximize online visibility, revenue, occupancy, and brand awareness. The role manages digital channels, online travel agencies (OTAs), distribution platforms, promotional campaigns, and digital content while ensuring consistency with the hotel’s brand standards and commercial objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement marketing and e-commerce strategies aligned with the hotel’s business objectives and brand positioning.

  • Manage the hotel’s online presence across the official website, OTAs, booking platforms, and other digital channels.

  • Monitor and optimize room availability, rates, promotions, packages, and inventory across all distribution channels.

  • Maintain accurate and engaging hotel content, including room descriptions, images, amenities, facilities, and promotional offers.

  • Manage relationships and day-to-day communication with OTAs, distribution partners, and relevant digital platforms.

  • Coordinate digital marketing campaigns across social media, search engines, email marketing, and other online channels.

  • Monitor online performance, conversion rates, website traffic, booking trends, and revenue contribution by channel.

  • Analyze market trends, competitor activities, customer behavior, and digital performance to identify business opportunities.

  • Support revenue management initiatives by ensuring rate parity, availability, and optimal distribution across channels.

  • Coordinate with Sales, Revenue Management, Reservations, Front Office, and Operations to ensure alignment of commercial strategies.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized General Accountant to join our Finance & Accounting team. The General Accountant will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, performing account reconciliations, supporting month-end closing, and ensuring that financial transactions are properly recorded in accordance with hotel policies and accounting standards.

The ideal candidate will have previous accounting experience, preferably within a 4- or 5-star hotel, with strong attention to detail and a good understanding of hospitality accounting operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date general ledger accounts.
  • Record and verify daily financial transactions and journal entries.
  • Perform monthly bank, balance sheet, and general ledger reconciliations.
  • Assist with month-end and year-end closing procedures.
  • Prepare and maintain supporting schedules for balance sheet accounts.
  • Review accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions when required.
  • Monitor and reconcile intercompany accounts and internal transfers.
  • Ensure proper recording and allocation of hotel revenues, expenses, and other financial transactions.
  • Assist in preparing monthly financial reports and management reports.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies in accounting records.
  • Support the preparation of accruals, prepayments, provisions, and adjusting entries.
  • Ensure compliance with hotel financial policies, accounting standards, and internal controls.
  • Maintain proper documentation and filing of accounting records.
  • Assist with internal and external audits by providing required schedules and supporting documents.
  • Work closely with other Finance team members and hotel departments to ensure accurate financial reporting.
  • Assist the Financial Controller and Chief Accountant with ad hoc financial and accounting tasks.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in a 4- or 5-star hotel.
  • Good knowledge of general accounting principles and financial reporting.
  • Strong understanding of reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, and prepayments.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting/ERP systems.
  • Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and work effectively in a fast-paced hotel environment.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism.
  • Previous experience in a luxury or international hotel.
  • Knowledge of hospitality revenue, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and income audit processes.
  • Professional accounting certification or qualification is an advantage.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, every arrival sets the tone and every departure leaves a lasting impression. As Bell Captain, you will lead the Bell team in creating smooth, welcoming, and memorable guest experiences from the moment guests arrive at the resort until the moment they leave.

Working closely with the Concierge, Front Office, and Valet teams, you will oversee daily Bell Desk operations, luggage handling, guest assistance, and transportation coordination. With a hands-on leadership style and a strong presence across the lobby and arrival areas, you will guide the team to deliver service with warmth, confidence, and the distinctive personality of SLS The Red Sea.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and supervise the daily operations of the Bell team, ensuring smooth and consistent service across all guest arrivals and departures.
  • Maintain a visible and engaging presence in the lobby, driveway, and resort arrival areas, supporting guests and colleagues throughout the shift.
  • Personally welcome and assist guests upon arrival and departure, creating memorable first and last impressions.
  • Oversee luggage handling, storage, delivery, and collection, ensuring all items are handled securely, accurately, and efficiently.
  • Ensure proper luggage tagging, logging, tracking, and storage procedures are followed at all times.
  • Coordinate closely with Front Office and Concierge teams to support guest arrivals, departures, room moves, and other guest requirements.
  • Assist with transportation arrangements, including airport transfers, private transfers, and other guest mobility requirements.
  • Coordinate with Valet and transportation teams to ensure smooth guest movements and efficient arrivals and departures.
  • Stay informed of VIP arrivals, repeat guests, special requests, and individual preferences to support personalized service.
  • Provide accurate and engaging information about resort facilities, dining venues, activities, experiences, Shura Island, and the wider Red Sea destination.
  • Handle guest inquiries, requests, and concerns professionally, ensuring appropriate action and follow-up.
  • Supervise the secure storage of guest luggage and personal belongings while maintaining accurate records.
  • Ensure bell carts, luggage rooms, storage areas, and related equipment are clean, organized, secure, and ready for operation.
  • Maintain the presentation and organization of the lobby, resort entrance, arrival areas, and Bell Desk in line with SLS standards.
  • Conduct team briefings and provide ongoing guidance on service standards, safety procedures, guest engagement, and daily resort operations.
  • Coach and support Bell team members, providing real-time feedback and identifying opportunities for development.
  • Monitor team performance and ensure colleagues consistently demonstrate professional grooming, conduct, and guest engagement.
  • Ensure guest requests and related tasks are properly recorded, tracked, and followed through using the relevant resort systems.
  • Coordinate closely with Concierge, Front Office, Guest Relations, Valet, Security, Housekeeping, and other resort departments to ensure seamless service delivery.
  • Ensure all safety, security, guest privacy, and luggage-handling procedures are followed consistently.
  • Support the preparation of Bell Desk operational reports, guest feedback, and relevant team updates when required.
  • Support the Rooms team with operational requirements and continuous improvement of the overall guest arrival and departure experience.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Minimum of 2 years of experience within Bell Desk, Front Office, Concierge, or Guest Services, preferably within a luxury or lifestyle resort environment.
  • Previous supervisory or team leadership experience is preferred.
  • Strong guest service and interpersonal skills with a warm, confident, and proactive approach.
  • Excellent communication skills in English; Arabic or additional languages are an advantage.
  • Working knowledge of Opera PMS, guest request management systems, or similar hospitality technology is preferred.
  • Good knowledge of transportation arrangements, destination experiences, and guest activities.
  • Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to lead, coach, and motivate a team while remaining hands-on during busy operations.
  • Physically able to assist with luggage handling and remain active for extended periods.
  • Flexible to work varying shifts, weekends, and public holidays according to resort operational requirements.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, the night never means the experience slows down. As Night Manager (Saudi National), you will be the senior leader overseeing the hotel’s overnight operations, ensuring our guests continue to receive the same seamless, attentive, and distinctive SLS experience throughout the night.

With a confident and hands-on approach, you will lead the overnight team, oversee hotel operations, and act as the key point of contact for guest and operational matters after hours. From VIP arrivals and service recovery to night audit, safety, and cross-department coordination, you will ensure every detail is handled with care while keeping the hotel running smoothly and setting the team up for a successful day ahead.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee overnight hotel operations, ensuring service, safety, and operational standards are maintained across all areas.
  • Act as the senior management representative during the night shift and serve as the main point of contact for guest and operational matters.
  • Maintain a visible presence in the lobby and public areas, engaging with guests and supporting the team whenever required.
  • Oversee night audit procedures, room assignments, late arrivals, early departures, group movements, and VIP arrivals and departures.
  • Personally welcome and assist VIP and loyalty guests, ensuring preferences and special arrangements are delivered accurately.
  • Handle guest feedback, complaints, and service recovery professionally, ensuring appropriate resolution and follow-up.
  • Ensure guest requests, preferences, and special arrangements are properly recorded, communicated, and followed through.
  • Conduct regular property walkthroughs to monitor safety, cleanliness, presentation, and overall service standards throughout the night.
  • Serve as the overnight emergency response lead and coordinate with Security, Engineering, and other relevant teams when incidents occur.
  • Ensure compliance with hotel safety, security, health, hygiene, and emergency procedures during overnight operations.
  • Coordinate closely with Front Office, Housekeeping, Engineering, Security, and other departments to ensure smooth overnight operations.
  • Lead shift briefings and handovers, ensuring important guest, operational, and safety information is clearly communicated between shifts.
  • Lead, support, and coach overnight colleagues, providing guidance and on-the-spot support when required.
  • Monitor colleague grooming, conduct, and guest engagement to ensure alignment with SLS standards.
  • Support the Night Auditor with daily revenue balancing, transaction reconciliation, discrepancies, and completion of night audit requirements.
  • Review high-balance accounts, open paymasters, credit risks, rebates, adjustments, and other financial matters in line with hotel procedures.
  • Authorize late check-outs, complimentary postings, paid-outs, rebates, and adjustments within assigned authority.
  • Identify and support upselling opportunities while contributing to Front Office revenue performance.
  • Ensure guest registrations and records are accurate and completed in accordance with hotel procedures and applicable Saudi tourism requirements.
  • Maintain accurate guest information in Opera PMS, including preferences, profiles, identification details, and relevant stay information.
  • Review and maintain the Duty Manager Logbook, ensuring clear records and appropriate follow-up for the morning and leadership teams.
  • Manage overbooking or other unexpected operational situations effectively, ensuring alternative arrangements maintain the expected guest experience.
  • Monitor the overnight presentation and atmosphere of the lobby and public areas, including lighting, music, scent, and overall appearance.
  • Prepare and communicate overnight reports, incidents, outstanding matters, and key updates to the relevant teams and senior leaders.
  • Support the continuous improvement of guest satisfaction, service recovery, upselling, guest preference recognition, and other Front Office performance indicators.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Front Office operations, with previous experience in a supervisory or leadership role.
  • Previous experience within a luxury, lifestyle, or high-end hospitality environment is preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of Opera PMS and Microsoft Office.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW 

The Receiving Clerk is responsible for accurately receiving, inspecting, and recording all incoming goods and supplies. The role ensures that deliveries match purchase orders in terms of quantity, quality, and condition, while maintaining proper documentation and updating inventory records. It also involves identifying discrepancies, coordinating with suppliers and internal departments, and supporting effective stock control and smooth operational flow. 

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Receive all incoming goods, materials, and supplies from vendors and suppliers 

  • Inspect deliveries to ensure items match purchase orders in quantity, quality, and specifications 

  • Verify delivery documentation such as invoices, delivery notes, and purchase orders 

  • Record all received items accurately into the inventory or procurement system 

  • Report and document any damaged, missing, or incorrect items 

  • Coordinate with purchasing and suppliers to resolve discrepancies or issues 

  • Ensure proper labeling, tagging, and documentation of received stock 

  • Assist in organizing and storing goods in designated storage areas or warehouses 

  • Maintain accurate receiving logs and records for audit and tracking purposes 

  • Follow up on pending or partial deliveries with suppliers 

  • Ensure compliance with company policies and receiving procedures 

  • Assist in stock counts and inventory reconciliation when required 

  • Maintain cleanliness and order in the receiving area 

  • Ensure proper handling of perishable or sensitive items (if applicable) 

  • Support internal departments with supply requests and distribution coordination 

  • Maintain safety standards during unloading and handling of goods 

  • Assist in preparing reports related to receiving activities and inventory status

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• High school diploma or equivalent; diploma in logistics, supply chain, or business is an advantage 

  • 1–3 years of experience in receiving, warehousing, inventory, or stores operations (preferably in hospitality or retail) 

  • Basic understanding of inventory control and procurement processes 

  • Familiarity with purchase orders, delivery notes, and stock documentation 

  • Experience using inventory or ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle NetSuite, or similar systems is an advantage 

  • Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for record keeping and reporting

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
SKILLS 

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy 

  • Good organizational and record-keeping skills 

  • Basic numerical and counting skills 

  • Ability to verify and inspect goods carefully 

  • Communication skills for coordinating with suppliers and internal teams 

  • Problem-solving skills to handle discrepancies and delivery issues 

  • Time management and ability to handle multiple deliveries 

  • Physical ability to handle loading/unloading tasks when required 

  • Teamwork and cooperation skills 

  • Integrity and honesty in handling goods and records 

  • Knowledge of safety and warehouse procedures 

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW 

The Income Auditor is responsible for reviewing, verifying, and reconciling all revenue transactions to ensure accuracy and completeness of financial records. The role ensures that all income from operations is correctly recorded, properly supported, and compliant with company policies and accounting standards. It also helps identify discrepancies, prevent revenue loss, and support accurate financial reporting. 

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Audit and verify daily revenue reports from all operational outlets 

  • Reconcile system-generated revenue with actual cash, credit card, and other payments 

  • Review and check all billing, postings, and corrections for accuracy 

  • Ensure proper recording of room revenue, food and beverage sales, and other income sources 

  • Investigate and resolve revenue discrepancies and variances 

  • Check cashier reports, settlement records, and cash handling procedures 

  • Verify voids, discounts, rebates, and complimentary postings for authorization 

  • Prepare daily income audit reports and summaries for management 

  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, policies, and accounting standards 

  • Reconcile credit card transactions with bank settlements 

  • Review night audit reports and correct any posting errors 

  • Support month-end closing and financial reporting processes 

  • Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for all revenue transactions 

  • Coordinate with front office, food & beverage, and finance teams regarding revenue issues 

  • Identify risks of revenue leakage and recommend corrective actions 

  • Assist internal and external auditors during audits 

  • Ensure confidentiality and accuracy of all financial data related to income records

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field 

  • Diploma in Accounting or Hospitality Management is an advantage 

  • 2–4+ years of experience in auditing, accounting, or hotel finance (preferably in hospitality) 

  • Strong understanding of revenue accounting and internal control procedures 

  • Knowledge of hotel systems such as POS, PMS, and financial reporting tools 

  • Familiarity with accounting systems such as SAP, Oracle NetSuite, or similar platforms 

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for reconciliation and reporting

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
SKILLS 

  • Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy  

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills  

  • Revenue auditing and reconciliation skills  

  • Good understanding of cash handling and credit card settlement processes  

  • Ability to identify discrepancies and financial irregularities  

  • Strong organizational and time management skills  

  • Ability to work with large volumes of financial data  

  • Effective communication and coordination skills  

  • Knowledge of internal controls and compliance standards  

  • Ability to work independently and meet strict deadlines  

  • Integrity and confidentiality in handling financial information  

  • Team collaboration with finance and operational departments

jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW 

The Accounts Receivable role is responsible for managing incoming payments, maintaining accurate customer accounts, and ensuring timely collection of outstanding invoices. The position involves issuing invoices, tracking payments, reconciling accounts, and following up on overdue balances to support healthy cash flow. It also includes maintaining financial records, resolving billing discrepancies, and coordinating with clients and internal departments to ensure accurate and efficient receivables management. 

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Issue and process customer invoices accurately and on time  

  • Record and post incoming payments to customer accounts  

  • Monitor outstanding balances and ensure timely collections  

  • Follow up on overdue accounts through calls and emails  

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer account records  

  • Reconcile customer accounts and resolve billing discrepancies  

  • Prepare accounts receivable aging reports  

  • Support cash flow management by tracking receivables  

  • Coordinate with sales and customer service teams regarding billing issues  

  • Ensure compliance with company credit and billing policies  

  • Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies and disputes  

  • Assist in month-end closing and financial reporting processes  

  • Maintain proper documentation for all transactions and invoices  

  • Process credit notes, refunds, and adjustments when required  

  • Communicate with clients to ensure clarity of billing and payment terms  

  • Support audits by providing necessary receivables documentation  

  • Maintain confidentiality and accuracy in financial records

  • Diploma in Accounting or Bookkeeping is an advantage  

  • 1–3+ years of experience in accounts receivable, accounting, or finance roles  

  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and receivables processes  

  • Familiarity with invoicing, billing cycles, and credit terms  

  • Experience using accounting systems such as SAP, Oracle NetSuite, or similar systems

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Kids Club/Youth Club Assistant Manager supports the management and daily operation of the hotel’s Kids Club, Youth Club, and recreational activities, ensuring engaging, safe, and memorable experiences for children, teenagers, and families.

The role assists in leading the Recreation team, developing creative activity programs, maintaining the highest standards of safety and supervision, and delivering personalized experiences aligned with the standards of luxury hospitality.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist in managing the daily operations of the Kids Club, Youth Club, and assigned recreation facilities and activities.
  • Supervise, guide, and support Kids Club, Youth Club, and Recreation team members during daily operations.
  • Plan, coordinate, and implement engaging recreational, educational, creative, cultural, and entertainment programs for different age groups.
  • Ensure activities are age-appropriate, inclusive, safe, and delivered according to established standards.
  • Create memorable and personalized experiences for children, teenagers, and families.
  • Monitor the supervision of children and teenagers and ensure established safeguarding and safety procedures are followed at all times.
  • Ensure registration, sign-in, sign-out, and authorized collection procedures are properly followed.
  • Maintain appropriate team-to-child supervision levels during all activities.
  • Conduct regular inspections of Kids Club, Youth Club, recreation areas, equipment, toys, and activity spaces.
  • Ensure all facilities and equipment are clean, safe, organized, and maintained to the highest standards.
  • Identify and report safety hazards, damaged equipment, maintenance requirements, or operational concerns.
  • Assist in preparing weekly and seasonal recreation calendars and special activity programs.
  • Support the organization of family activities, themed events, celebrations, and special recreational experiences.
  • Engage professionally with parents and guardians and provide clear information regarding activities, schedules, and safety procedures.
  • Handle guest requests, feedback, and concerns professionally and escalate matters when required.
  • Assist with team scheduling, task allocation, training, coaching, and performance monitoring.
  • Conduct team briefings and ensure operational information and guest requirements are communicated effectively.
  • Monitor recreational supplies, equipment, games, and materials and coordinate replenishment requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records, attendance information, incident reports, and operational documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with hotel policies, child safeguarding requirements, health and safety procedures, and applicable regulations.
  • Coordinate with Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Spa, Security, and other departments to support seamless family experiences.
  • Support Recreation management with departmental planning, reporting, budgeting, and operational requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by Recreation management.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Recreation, Sports Management, Child Development, Education, or a related field is preferred.
  • Previous experience in Kids Club, Youth Club, Recreation, Family Experience, or a similar hospitality environment.
  • Previous supervisory or team leadership experience is preferred.
  • Luxury hotel, resort, or family-focused hospitality experience is highly desirable.
  • Good knowledge of recreational programming and age-appropriate activities for children and teenagers.
  • Strong understanding of child safeguarding, supervision, health, and safety requirements.
  • First Aid and CPR certification is preferred.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends, holidays, and shifts, according to hotel operations.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information

SKILL

  • Strong leadership and team supervision skills.
  • Excellent guest service and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong understanding of child safety and safeguarding practices.
  • Creative activity planning and programming skills.
  • Ability to engage effectively with children, teenagers, and families.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Good organizational and planning abilities.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Strong attention to safety and detail.
  • Ability to handle guest feedback and operational situations professionally.
  • Good time management and prioritization abilities.
  • Teamwork and cross-departmental coordination skills.
  • Positive, energetic, and professional approach.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced luxury hospitality environment.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Cafeteria Attendant is responsible for supporting the daily operation of the team member cafeteria, ensuring food and beverage service areas are clean, organized, well-stocked, and maintained according to the highest standards of hygiene and service. The role provides friendly and efficient service while supporting a positive dining experience for all team members.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prepare and maintain the cafeteria service and dining areas before, during, and after meal periods.
  • Assist with the setup, replenishment, and clearing of food and beverage stations.
  • Ensure food, beverages, cutlery, crockery, trays, and other service items are available and properly arranged.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of tables, chairs, counters, service stations, and surrounding areas.
  • Clear used dishes, trays, and utensils promptly and transfer them to the designated washing areas.
  • Monitor food and beverage stations and replenish items as required during service.
  • Provide courteous and efficient service to team members using the cafeteria.
  • Follow food hygiene, sanitation, and food safety procedures at all times.
  • Ensure food is handled, displayed, and stored according to established hygiene and safety standards.
  • Support portion control and minimize food waste in accordance with departmental procedures.
  • Assist with receiving and organizing cafeteria supplies when required.
  • Report shortages, equipment issues, maintenance requirements, or hygiene concerns to the supervisor.
  • Follow proper waste segregation and disposal procedures.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and hygienic working environment.
  • Support cleaning and closing procedures at the end of each meal period.
  • Follow hotel policies, grooming standards, and health and safety procedures.
  • Coordinate effectively with Culinary, Stewarding, and other relevant departments.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor or management.

  • Good time management and prioritization abilities.

  • Ability to maintain service areas in a clean and organized condition.
  • Ability to work efficiently during busy meal periods.
  • Positive and professional attitude.
  • Reliability and punctuality.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform other duties as assigned by Engineering management.

jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Kitchen Technician is responsible for the inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of commercial kitchen equipment and related systems throughout the hotel. The role ensures that kitchen equipment operates safely, efficiently, and reliably to support uninterrupted Food & Beverage operations and maintain the highest standards of safety, hygiene, and operational performance.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on commercial kitchen equipment and appliances.
  • Inspect, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain cooking, refrigeration, heating, and food preparation equipment.
  • Maintain equipment such as ovens, ranges, grills, fryers, dishwashers, ice machines, refrigerators, freezers, and other commercial kitchen appliances.
  • Diagnose electrical, mechanical, and basic plumbing faults related to kitchen equipment.
  • Respond promptly to kitchen maintenance requests and equipment breakdowns to minimize operational disruption.
  • Conduct regular inspections of kitchen equipment to identify defects, wear, or potential failures.
  • Complete preventive maintenance activities according to established schedules and manufacturer recommendations.
  • Assist with the installation, testing, and commissioning of new kitchen equipment when required.
  • Coordinate with Engineering and Food & Beverage teams regarding maintenance requirements and equipment availability.
  • Ensure all maintenance activities comply with health, safety, hygiene, and hotel standards.
  • Maintain accurate records of repairs, inspections, preventive maintenance, and equipment servicing.
  • Monitor spare parts and materials required for kitchen equipment maintenance and report replenishment needs.
  • Maintain tools and work areas in a clean, safe, and organized condition.
  • Report major equipment defects or recurring technical issues to the Engineering Supervisor.
  • Support energy conservation and equipment efficiency initiatives.
  • Assist other Engineering team members with technical and maintenance activities when required.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by Engineering management.

qualifications.title: Qualifications

jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Mechanic Technician is responsible for the inspection, maintenance, repair, and efficient operation of mechanical equipment and systems throughout the hotel. The role supports the Engineering team in ensuring that all mechanical installations and equipment operate safely, reliably, and efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of hotel operations and guest experience.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform routine inspections, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs of mechanical equipment and systems.
  • Maintain pumps, motors, valves, compressors, water systems, and other mechanical equipment.
  • Identify mechanical faults and carry out necessary corrective maintenance in a timely manner.
  • Respond promptly to maintenance requests and technical issues from guest areas and hotel departments.
  • Conduct regular inspections of plant rooms, mechanical areas, and equipment to ensure safe and efficient operation.
  • Follow preventive maintenance schedules and complete assigned work orders accurately and on time.
  • Assist with the installation, replacement, testing, and commissioning of mechanical equipment when required.
  • Monitor equipment performance and report abnormalities, defects, or potential failures to the Engineering Supervisor.
  • Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with safety procedures, hotel standards, and applicable regulations.
  • Maintain tools, equipment, and work areas in a clean, safe, and organized condition.
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, repairs, inspections, and equipment servicing.
  • Assist other Engineering team members with maintenance activities and operational requirements when necessary.
  • Support energy conservation and sustainability initiatives within the Engineering department.
  • Follow proper procedures for handling spare parts, materials, and engineering supplies.
  • Respond to emergency maintenance situations and support the Engineering team in restoring operations safely and efficiently.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by Engineering management.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Technical diploma or vocational qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Maintenance, or a related field.
  • Previous experience as a Mechanic Technician or in a similar mechanical maintenance role.
  • Hospitality, resort, or large facility maintenance experience is preferred.
  • Good knowledge of mechanical systems, pumps, motors, valves, and associated equipment.
  • Understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance practices.
  • Basic knowledge of workplace health and safety requirements.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends, holidays, and shifts, as required by hotel operations.
