jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Events Manager at Faena The Red Sea is responsible for leading the planning, 
coordination, and flawless execution of social, corporate, cultural, wellness, and high-profile 
private events within the resort. This role transforms spaces into extraordinary experiences, 
ensuring every event reflects the theatrical elegance, creativity, and elevated service 
synonymous with the Faena brand.
Based on property, the Events Manager serves as the primary point of contact for confirmed 
events from initial handover through execution, working closely with clients, Sales, Culinary, 
Operations, Wellness, and Executive teams to deliver bespoke occasions ranging from 
intimate celebrations to exclusive buyouts and destination gatherings.
This role is instrumental in positioning Faena The Red Sea as one of the most sought-after 
event destinations in the Kingdom and beyond.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  •  Manage all confirmed events from contract handover to post-event follow-up, ensuring seamless execution at every stage. 
  • Serve as the main liaison for clients, hosts, agencies, wedding planners, corporate organizers, and VIP representatives. 
  • Plan and coordinate weddings, private celebrations, executive retreats, brand launches, wellness events, incentive groups, cultural programming, and luxury gatherings. 
  • Conduct site inspections, planning meetings, tastings, rehearsals, and operational briefings. 
  • Prepare detailed event orders, function sheets, rooming lists, timelines, and billing instructions. 
  • Collaborate closely with Sales and Revenue teams to maximize conversion, upsell opportunities, and total event profitability. 
  • Work with Culinary, Rooms, Spa, Security, Engineering, Housekeeping, and F&B teams to ensure all operational requirements are delivered flawlessly. 
  • Curate bespoke guest experiences including décor, entertainment, gifting, wellness rituals, transportation, and VIP touches. 
  • Oversee event setup, execution, and breakdown while maintaining luxury service standards throughout. 
  • Manage supplier relationships including florists, production companies, entertainment partners, AV vendors, and specialty contractors. 
  • Ensure all events comply with resort policies, safety standards, permits, and local regulations. 
  • Monitor budgets, deposits, final billing, and event profitability in coordination with Finance. 
  • Maintain accurate records, forecasting, and event pipeline reports within Delphi / CRM systems. 
  • Support pre-opening event strategy including venue positioning, packages, preferred supplier lists, and launch showcases. 
  • Identify opportunities to elevate Faena’s reputation through signature programming and memorable moments.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
•  Minimum 3–5 years of experience in luxury hotel events, catering sales, weddings, or event operations. 
  • Previous experience in ultra-luxury resorts, destination hotels, lifestyle brands, or iconic event venues preferred. 
  • Strong background in weddings, VIP events, incentive groups, and high-touch private celebrations. 
  • Pre-opening experience is highly desirable. 
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with strong attention to detail. 
  • Calm under pressure with the ability to lead complex events in fast-paced environments. 
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and client relationship skills. 
  • Commercial mindset with understanding of event revenue, budgeting, and upselling. 
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, Opera, Delphi, or event management systems. 
  • Fluent English required; Arabic strongly preferred. Additional languages are an advantage. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, Events Management, Business, or related field preferred.

JOB OVERVIEW 

The Director of Spa & Wellness leads the vision, experience, and operational excellence of Tierra Santa Healing House – The Red Sea, a South American–inspired sanctuary dedicated to the art of living well. This role curates transformative journeys that blend ancient healing rituals, shamanic traditions, indigenous ingredients, energetic practices, and state-of-the-art longevity science to elevate guests’ wellbeing.  

 

As guardian of the Tierra Santa ethos, the Director shapes immersive wellness programming, drives service excellence, develops a world-class team, and ensures each guest experience ignites rejuvenation, consciousness, and spiritual vitality while positioning Tierra Santa Healing House as a signature wellness destination within FAENA The Red Sea. 

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Champion the Tierra Santa Healing House philosophy, setting the strategic wellness vision and ensuring alignment with Faena brand standards. 

  • Lead, inspire, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of therapists, healers, technicians, and wellness specialists. 

  • Foster a culture of creativity, authenticity, emotional hospitality, and transformative guest experiences. 

  • Oversee daily operations of the spa, hammam, wet areas, treatment rooms, consultation spaces, and wellness programs. 

  • Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, safety, ambience, and ritual-based service delivery. 

  • Implement operating procedures, treatment protocols, and service rituals that reflect Tierra Santa’s holistic and South American–inspired identity. 

  • Curate a world-class menu of therapies incorporating shamanic wisdom, energy healing, somatic practices, indigenous ingredients, and advanced technology. 

  • Design and evolve personalised wellness journeys, longevity programs, and seasonal rituals. 

  • Monitor guest satisfaction, lead continuous improvement, and elevate experience touchpoints. 

  • Develop and manage departmental budgets, revenue forecasts, cost controls, and performance KPIs. 

  • Drive financial success through treatment optimisation, retail strategy, membership initiatives, and programming innovation. 

  • Analyse business trends and create new offerings to maximise profitability and competitive positioning. 

  • Recruit, train, and develop exceptional spa, wellness, and holistic practitioners. 

  • Ensure all team members deliver both technical excellence and Faena-level emotional hospitality. 

  • Lead ongoing training in wellness modalities, rituals, guest engagement, and cultural storytelling. 

  • Collaborate with medical consultants, longevity experts, brand partners, and wellness innovators to evolve the wellness portfolio. 

  • Integrate diagnostic testing, modern therapies, and alternative healing into cohesive guest journeys. 

  • Stay ahead of global wellness and longevity trends to maintain Tierra Santa’s leadership position. 

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory standards, health and safety guidelines, and Faena brand requirements. 

  • Maintain exceptional quality across products, equipment, suppliers, and wellness technologies.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Minimum 5–7 years of senior leadership experience in luxury or lifestyle wellness operations across spa, fitness, or recreation within a 5-star resort or standalone wellness brand.  

  • Proven track record in managing multi-outlet or large-scale wellness facilities including spa operations and health club management.  

  • Degree or diploma in Spa Management, Hospitality, Health & Wellness, or related field preferred.  

  • Deep understanding of wellness, fitness, and spa trends with a passion for curating distinctive guest experiences.  

  • Commercially savvy, with strong financial acumen and ability to drive revenue while maintaining elevated service standards.  

  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to inspire teams, handle guest concerns with professionalism, and represent the department confidently.  

  • Fluent in English; Arabic language skills are an advantage.  

  • High degree of discretion, confidentiality, and emotional intelligence.  

  • Multilingual skills preferred (English required, Spanish/French/Portuguese a plus).

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
SKILLS 

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with a natural flair for luxury service. 

  • Ability to resolve complex guest situations with professionalism and discretion.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Responsible for the professional and cost-effective running of the Housekeeping department achieving high standards of cleanliness for guest rooms, public areas and back of house areas within the hotel.

§ Overseeing the cleaning of guest rooms and public areas ensuring through inspection that standards of cleanliness and guest comfort are maintained in accordance with Hotel and Brand standards

§ To plan, organise and keep an accurate record by room of all additional cleaning carried out to ensure maximum cleanliness and logical work patterns

§ Ensure that room cleaning productivity is monitored closely and maintained at the level set by the General Manager

§ To be responsible for the efficient running of the laundry and cost-effective use of all linen within the hotel taking inventory on a regular basis and investigating stock losses

§ To be responsible for the handling of guest laundry and lost property in accordance with Hotel Policy

§ To liaise with Front Office and Maintenance in regard to readiness of rooms with particular attention to guest’s special requirements and VIP rooms

§ To ensure the security of keys, storerooms and guest bedrooms

§ To liaise with the General Manager regarding use of outside contractors for deep cleaning duties, ensuring work is checked and standards achieved as stated in the service contract.

§ To ensure corridors and back of house areas are cleaned to standards specified in hotel policy

§ Adherence to Emergency Communication procedures

§ Strive to implement the Sofitel Vision and demonstrate active use of Sofitel Values.

§ Prepare weekly staffing schedules, monitoring staff attendance and labour planning to meet with activity in the Hotel so as to maintain cost effectiveness.

§ Maintain an accurate and proper inventory of all stocks, guest supplies, linens etc to prevent pilferage or loss of any nature

§ Build, develop and drive Housekeeping ambassadors to assist in achieving the Hotel deliverables, and ensure the team are highly engaged. This includes responsible and sustainable recruitment, training and development plans for all ambassadors, open and honest feedback to ambassadors, and engagement strategies.

§ As a member of the Senior Leadership Team, role is responsible for ensuring their department’s communication to broader hotel is clear, concise and respectful. Role is also responsible for ensuring departments performance is aligned with the hotel’s strategic goals.

§ Role also plays an important part of forming and executing the hotel’s strategic plan with the General Manager and working with the Senior Leadership team to drive overall hotel’s performance. This also includes high level assistance during emergency situations and adherence to Emergency Communications procedures.

§ Provide required month end reports and data for General Manager and Finance. § Ensure that the control and replenishment of the hotel room mini-bar is properly recorded and stock is controlled in line with Sofitel policies and procedures § Prepare various monthly reports and submit them to the General Manager.

§ Accountable for the proper usage of all equipment and their periodical servicing to ensure efficient working conditions

§ Ensure that room cleaning productivity is well respected within the parameters given by the management. As well as maintaining a high standard in terms of cleanliness and tidiness.

§ Facilitate the smooth running of the departments through adequate purchase and supply of material and equipment. § Adhere to the department budget through the purchase order system and inventory controls.

§ Be proactive in controlling costs being fully aware of forecasted business and targeted profitability whilst maintaining standards. § Implement training programs for ambassadors, conduct induction and skills training.

§ Ensure department policies and procedures are understood by all ambassadors and observed in tasks performed.

§ Handle or resolve all guest complaints and establish amicable relations with guests of the hotel and look after their needs and comforts at all times

§ Through close supervision recommend improvements in operation, especially in the following aspects of developing a better service standard, increase in revenue and reduction of cost

§ Any other reasonable request within your range of competence as required by your Manager.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
§ Previous Housekeeping management experience, in a similar role is essential.

§ Experienced in the luxury market, previous 5 Star experience essential.

§ Strong operational background with experience in the implementation and management of brand standards

§ Experience in the coaching and development of a professional management team.

§ Sound knowledge of Opera and Microsoft applications.

§ Proven experience with cost control including payroll, expenses and forecasting

§ Well groomed & articulate in communication.

§ Fluent written and spoken English

§ Excellent time management, organisational skills and ability to work autonomously.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, wellness is more than a treatment — it’s an experience designed to restore, recharge, and inspire. As a Spa Therapist, you will create personalized moments of relaxation and well-being through professional treatments, thoughtful guest care, and the distinctive spirit of SLS.

Working closely with the Spa team, you will deliver a range of treatments while ensuring every guest feels welcomed, comfortable, and cared for throughout their spa journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform a variety of massage, facial, and body treatments in accordance with professional certifications and spa protocols.
  • Welcome guests warmly and guide them through their treatment experience.
  • Understand individual guest needs and personalize treatments where appropriate.
  • Recommend suitable spa treatments, wellness experiences, and home-care products.
  • Build positive guest relationships and encourage repeat visits through exceptional service.
  • Support spa service and retail sales targets through appropriate guest recommendations.
  • Prepare treatment rooms before each appointment and ensure all products, equipment, and linens are properly arranged.
  • Maintain high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, presentation, and safety across treatment areas.
  • Ensure treatment rooms provide the appropriate ambiance, including lighting, temperature, scent, and music.
  • Monitor treatment supplies and communicate replenishment needs to the Spa Supervisor.
  • Coordinate with Spa Reception, attendants, and fellow therapists to ensure a seamless guest journey.
  • Support opening, closing, and general spa operational duties as required.
  • Communicate guest feedback, special requests, or operational concerns to the Spa Supervisor.
  • Maintain all required professional licenses and certifications in line with local requirements.
  • Participate in training to continuously develop treatment techniques, service skills, and product knowledge.
  • Follow SLS grooming, service, health, safety, and hygiene standards at all times.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Valid professional certification or license in massage therapy, beauty therapy, esthetics, or a related wellness discipline.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience as a Spa Therapist, preferably within a luxury hotel, resort, spa, or wellness environment.
  • Strong knowledge of massage, body treatments, wellness practices, and treatment products.
  • Strong understanding of hygiene, sanitation, and professional treatment standards.
  • Guest-focused with a warm, polished, and professional approach.
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple appointments effectively.
  • Flexible and able to work effectively in a fast-paced luxury hospitality environment.
  • Genuine passion for wellness, hospitality, and creating memorable guest experiences.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, a villa stay is more than accommodation — it’s a highly personalized experience where every detail feels effortless. As a Villa Host, you will be the dedicated point of contact for our villa guests, creating a seamless and memorable journey from arrival through to their final farewell.

Working closely with Front Office, Housekeeping, F&B, Spa, Concierge, Transportation, and other resort teams, you will anticipate guest needs, coordinate personalized experiences, and ensure every moment reflects the distinctive spirit of SLS.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of the guest journey for assigned villas, from pre-arrival preparation through departure.
  • Review guest profiles, preferences, VIP status, and special occasions to prepare personalized experiences.
  • Conduct pre-arrival villa inspections to ensure cleanliness, amenities, maintenance, and overall presentation meet SLS standards.
  • Personally welcome villa guests and support seamless in-villa check-in and check-out experiences.
  • Build genuine relationships with guests and act as their key point of contact throughout their stay.
  • Anticipate guest needs and coordinate requests with relevant resort departments through to completion.
  • Arrange dining, spa and wellness experiences, resort activities, transportation, celebrations, and other personalized experiences.
  • Coordinate in-villa dining, minibar, laundry, luggage, and other villa services as required.
  • Ensure villa amenities, guest supplies, and special arrangements are prepared according to guest preferences.
  • Identify opportunities to create memorable and personalized moments for guests.
  • Respond promptly to guest requests, feedback, and concerns and support effective service recovery.
  • Maintain accurate guest preferences, requests, and relevant stay information within hotel systems.
  • Stay informed of daily arrivals, departures, VIP movements, resort activities, and operational updates.
  • Coordinate departure arrangements, including transportation, luggage, billing requirements, and individual guest requests.
  • Maintain the highest standards of guest privacy, discretion, grooming, and professional conduct.
  • Follow all SLS service standards, operational procedures, and health and safety requirements.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Diploma or qualification in Hospitality Management or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in luxury hospitality, preferably within Villa Operations, Butler Service, Guest Relations, Front Office, Concierge, or a similar guest-facing role.
  • Previous experience in a luxury resort, villa, private residence, or high-end hospitality environment is preferred.
  • Strong guest relations skills with the ability to anticipate needs and create personalized experiences.
  • Good understanding of luxury service standards, guest etiquette, privacy, and discretion.
  • Good knowledge of Front Office, F&B, Housekeeping, Concierge, and general resort operations.
  • Comfortable using Property Management Systems (PMS) and standard hotel systems.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a warm and professional presence.
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Flexible, proactive, and able to remain composed in a fast-paced luxury hospitality environment.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, exceptional guest experiences begin long before arrival — with the right products, partners, and decisions behind the scenes. As a Purchasing Manager, you will lead the hotel’s procurement activities, ensuring every purchase meets our standards of quality, value, and operational excellence.

Working closely with Finance and operational departments, you will manage supplier relationships, negotiate contracts, oversee purchasing activities, and develop sourcing strategies that support the hotel’s needs while maintaining strong cost control and procurement standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the hotel’s purchasing and procurement activities in line with operational requirements and budget.
  • Develop and implement procurement strategies that support the hotel’s operational and financial objectives.
  • Work closely with department heads to forecast purchasing needs and ensure timely availability of goods and supplies.
  • Source, evaluate, and onboard reliable suppliers that meet SLS quality and service standards.
  • Negotiate pricing, contracts, payment terms, and commercial agreements with suppliers.
  • Monitor supplier performance across quality, pricing, delivery, reliability, and compliance.
  • Review and manage purchase orders, contracts, quotations, and vendor documentation.
  • Monitor procurement spending and identify opportunities for cost savings without compromising quality.
  • Maintain appropriate inventory and purchasing levels based on operational requirements and business forecasts.
  • Ensure all purchasing activities comply with company policies, internal controls, and local regulations.
  • Identify and manage supply chain risks, including shortages, delays, and supplier performance issues.
  • Support sustainable and responsible sourcing initiatives wherever possible.
  • Lead, support, and develop the Purchasing team while maintaining effective collaboration across departments.
  • Maintain strong relationships with suppliers, Finance, and operational teams to ensure smooth procurement processes.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Minimum 5 years of purchasing or procurement experience, preferably within luxury hospitality, with at least 2 years in a managerial role.
  • Strong experience in supplier sourcing, contract negotiation, vendor management, and cost control.
  • Good understanding of hotel purchasing, inventory management, and procurement processes.
  • Experience with procurement systems such as FutureLog, Adaco, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, and commercial skills.
  • Good financial understanding with the ability to manage budgets and analyze procurement costs.
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, every detail matters — and every riyal counts. As a Cost Controller, you will play a key role in monitoring costs, controlling inventory, analyzing spending, and ensuring the hotel operates efficiently without compromising the exceptional experiences we create for our guests.

Working closely with Finance, Procurement, F&B, Culinary, and other operational teams, you will provide accurate cost insights, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure strong financial controls across the hotel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor daily costs and expenses across hotel departments, with a strong focus on F&B operations.
  • Review and analyze food and beverage costs, consumption, wastage, and inventory movement.
  • Conduct and audit regular inventories, stock counts, transfers, and spoilage reports.
  • Compare actual costs against budgets and forecasts, investigate variances, and highlight areas requiring action.
  • Work closely with Procurement to review purchase prices, purchase orders, and supplier-related cost information.
  • Review storeroom procedures, consumption records, and internal transfers to ensure accurate cost allocation and control.
  • Coordinate with Culinary and F&B teams on recipe costing, portion control, and menu cost analysis.
  • Prepare regular cost reports, including food cost, beverage cost, inventory movement, and other operational cost indicators.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce wastage, improve efficiency, and strengthen cost-control practices.
  • Support month-end closing activities, including inventory valuation, journal entries, accruals, and reconciliations.
  • Maintain accurate and audit-ready cost-control records and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure all cost-control activities follow hotel policies, internal controls, and Finance procedures.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in Cost Control, Finance, or a similar role, preferably within the hospitality industry.
  • Good understanding of cost accounting, inventory control, and F&B operations.
  • Experience with hospitality systems such as FMC, Adaco, FutureLog, Materials Control, Sun Systems, Opera, or Micros is an advantage.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and analytical skills.
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify cost variances and trends.
  • Good communication and coordination skills with the ability to work across operational departments.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and work effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW 

The Purchasing Officer is responsible for sourcing and procuring goods and services required for daily operations in a timely, cost-effective, and efficient manner. The role involves processing purchase requests, obtaining quotations, issuing purchase orders, and coordinating with suppliers to ensure accurate delivery of quality materials. It also supports inventory control, maintains procurement records, and works closely with internal departments to meet operational needs while following company purchasing policies and budgets. 

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Process purchase requisitions and convert them into purchase orders 

  • Source suppliers and request quotations for goods and services 

  • Compare prices, quality, and delivery terms to ensure best value 

  • Issue and track purchase orders to ensure timely delivery 

  • Coordinate with suppliers to confirm order details and delivery schedules 

  • Follow up on pending, delayed, or incomplete deliveries 

  • Ensure all purchases comply with company policies and approved budgets 

  • Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions and documentation 

  • Update and manage supplier database and contact information 

  • Coordinate with stores/warehouse to monitor stock levels and requirements 

  • Assist in resolving issues related to damaged, incorrect, or missing items 

  • Work closely with finance for invoice verification and payment processing 

  • Support inventory control and stock replenishment activities 

  • Ensure proper filing and documentation for audit purposes 

  • Assist in evaluating supplier performance and service quality 

  • Provide regular reports on purchasing activities and status updates 

  • Maintain strong communication with internal departments and vendors 

  • Ensure cost-effective purchasing and support budget control initiatives

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, or related field 

  • 1–3 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, or store operations 

  • Basic understanding of procurement processes and supplier management 

  • Familiarity with purchase orders, quotations, and inventory procedures 

  • Experience using ERP or procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle NetSuite is an advantage 

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data entry and reporting

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
SKILLS 

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy 

  • Good organizational and record-keeping skills 

  • Basic negotiation and communication skills 

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines 

  • Knowledge of procurement and purchasing procedures 

  • Problem-solving skills for delivery or supplier issues 

  • Time management and prioritization abilities 

  • Teamwork and coordination with internal departments 

  • Cost awareness and budget control understanding 

  • Ability to follow instructions and company policies 

  • Strong administrative and documentation skills 

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW 

The Paymaster is responsible for ensuring the accurate, timely, and confidential processing of employee payroll. This includes calculating salaries, wages, overtime, and deductions in compliance with company policies and Saudi labor laws. The role also maintains payroll records, resolves discrepancies, and works closely with HR and Finance to ensure proper payment of employees and adherence to statutory requirements. 

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Prepare and process monthly payroll for all employees accurately and on time 

  • Calculate salaries, wages, overtime, allowances, and deductions in line with company policies and labor laws 

  • Maintain and update employee payroll records and personal data 

  • Ensure compliance with Saudi labor regulations, including GOSI, tax, and end-of-service benefits 

  • Verify attendance, timesheets, and leave records before payroll processing 

  • Handle payroll discrepancies, adjustments, and employee queries 

  • Prepare payroll reports for Finance and Management review 

  • Coordinate with HR regarding new hires, terminations, and salary changes 

  • Process final settlements for resigned or terminated employees 

  • Ensure confidentiality and security of payroll information 

  • Reconcile payroll accounts with the general ledger 

  • Support audits by providing payroll records and documentation 

  • Manage bank transfer instructions for salary payments 

  • Ensure accurate deduction and payment of statutory contributions 

  • Assist in implementing payroll systems and process improvements 

  • Maintain compliance with internal controls and company policies 

  • Liaise with external authorities when required for payroll-related matters

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field 

  • Diploma in Payroll, Accounting, or Human Resources is an advantage 

  • 2–5+ years of experience in payroll or compensation administration, preferably in hospitality or large organizations 

  • Strong knowledge of payroll processes, labor laws, and statutory requirements in Saudi Arabia 

  • Understanding of GOSI, end-of-service benefits, and payroll compliance 

  • Experience with payroll/HR systems such as SAP, Oracle NetSuite, or similar platforms 

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for payroll calculations and reporting

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
SKILLS 

  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail 

  • Strong numerical and analytical skills 

  • Payroll processing and reconciliation skills 

  • Knowledge of compensation, benefits, and deductions 

  • Confidentiality and integrity in handling sensitive employee data 

  • Strong organizational and time management skills 

  • Problem-solving and discrepancy resolution abilities 

  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills 

  • Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines 

  • Strong understanding of HR and finance coordination processes 

  • Report preparation and data management skills 

  • Ability to adapt to payroll systems and process improvements

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
ROLE SUMMARY

As Director of Residences at Novotel Residences, you will lead and oversee the complete homeowner and resident experience, from pre-move-in preparations through day-to-day residential living. This pivotal role requires a proactive, professional, and guest-focused approach to ensure that residents consistently receive a high standard of hospitality and residential service in line with Novotel standards.

The role is responsible for creating a well-managed, comfortable, and welcoming residential environment, building strong relationships with homeowners and residents, and ensuring the highest standards of operational efficiency, service quality, and community experience.

What you will be doing:

  • Strategically lead and manage the complete Resident Journey across all stages, from pre-move-in through ongoing residency.
  • Establish, implement, and maintain high standards of residential service through comprehensive operational procedures, policies, and training programs.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve service delivery to ensure consistency, efficiency, and resident satisfaction.
  • Build and maintain strong, professional, and lasting relationships with homeowners and residents, acting as the primary point of contact for residential needs, inquiries, and service-related matters.
  • Direct and oversee all aspects of residential operations, including:
    • Maintenance and Engineering
    • Security and Access Control
    • Concierge Services
    • Housekeeping Standards
    • Residential Amenities
    • Common Areas and Facilities
  • Manage vendor and service provider contracts and monitor their performance to ensure quality, compliance, and value for money.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management, and development of residential employees.
  • Conduct regular inspections of residential units, common areas, amenities, and facilities to ensure that the property is maintained to the highest operational and presentation standards.
  • Foster strong collaboration with hotel departmental managers to ensure seamless coordination between the residential operation and hotel services, including:
    • Property & Engineering
    • Food & Beverage
    • Housekeeping
    • Security
    • Front Office and Guest Services
    • Spa and other available hotel facilities
    • Community Relations and Communications
  • Manage the financial performance of the residential operation and maintain effective budgetary control.
  • Assist in the preparation, monitoring, and administration of annual operating budgets and capital expenditure plans for the residential operation.

Role Summary

The Shift Engineer is responsible for supporting the smooth and safe operation of the hotel’s engineering and maintenance functions during the assigned shift. The role involves monitoring building systems, responding to maintenance requests, troubleshooting technical issues, and ensuring that all engineering operations are maintained according to hotel standards, safety requirements, and operational needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor the operation of the hotel’s electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, and other engineering systems during the assigned shift.
  • Respond promptly to maintenance requests, equipment breakdowns, and urgent engineering issues.
  • Perform basic troubleshooting and coordinate corrective maintenance to ensure the timely resolution of technical problems.
  • Conduct regular inspections of plant rooms, equipment, public areas, guest rooms, and back-of-house areas.
  • Support preventive maintenance activities and ensure scheduled tasks are completed properly.
  • Monitor critical equipment and report any abnormal conditions, failures, or safety concerns to the Engineering management.
  • Coordinate with other hotel departments regarding maintenance requests and operational requirements.
  • Ensure guest-related engineering issues are handled promptly and professionally to minimize disruption.
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, breakdowns, inspections, and shift handovers.
  • Support the proper operation of HVAC, electrical, water supply, fire and life safety, and other building systems.
  • Assist external contractors and service providers during maintenance, inspections, and technical works.
  • Ensure all engineering activities are carried out in accordance with hotel policies, safety procedures, and applicable regulations.
  • Conduct effective shift handovers and communicate all pending issues and critical matters to the incoming shift.
  • Support energy and utility monitoring initiatives and report unusual consumption or equipment performance.
  • Perform any other engineering duties assigned by the Chief Engineer or Engineering Management.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply; 0–2 years of relevant experience is preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, and building systems.
  • Basic understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and identify basic equipment faults.
  • Good knowledge of engineering safety procedures and HSE requirements.
  • Good command of English, both written and spoken; Arabic is an advantage.
  • Good computer skills, including Microsoft Office.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to work shifts, weekends, public holidays, and night shifts as required.
  • Highly motivated, responsible, and willing to learn and develop within a hotel engineering environment.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Department: Finance
Section: Credit / Accounts Receivable
Position: Credit Supervisor
Reports To: Director of Finance
Hotel: Mövenpick Hotel and Residence Hajar Tower Makkah
 

Job Purpose

The Credit Supervisor supports the effective management of the hotel’s Credit and Accounts Receivable function, ensuring accurate billing, timely collection of outstanding balances, proper credit control, and compliance with hotel policies and internal financial controls.

The role works closely with Finance and operational departments to protect the hotel’s financial interests while maintaining professional relationships with corporate clients, travel agencies, government accounts, groups, guests, and other business partners.

Key Responsibilities

Credit Control & Accounts Receivable

  • Supervise the day-to-day activities of the Credit and Accounts Receivable function.
  • Ensure all credit accounts are properly approved and supported by valid documentation in accordance with hotel credit policies.
  • Review new credit applications and ensure required documents, approvals, credit limits, and payment terms are complete.
  • Monitor credit limits and payment terms and highlight accounts requiring management attention.
  • Review the Accounts Receivable Aging Report regularly and follow up on outstanding balances.
  • Maintain systematic collection follow-up with companies, travel agents, government entities, groups, and other debtors.
  • Escalate significantly overdue or high-risk accounts to the Credit Manager and Director of Finance.
  • Support the hotel in controlling Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and minimizing bad-debt exposure.

qualifications.text:

Previous experience in Credit, Accounts Receivable, or Hotel Finance is required. Previous experience in a supervisory capacity within an international hotel environment is an advantage.

Strong knowledge of credit control, accounts receivable, and financial procedures.

Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and accounting systems.

Experience with Opera PMS or similar hotel systems is an advantage.

Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Good command of English and Arabic.

Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.

SOCPA certification or membership is preferred

JOB OVERVIEW 

The Purchasing Manager oversees the procurement of goods and services, ensuring they are obtained at the best quality, cost, and timing. JOB OVERVIEW 

The Accounts Payable role is a vital pillar of our Finance team, ensuring every transaction is handled with accuracy, integrity, and the refined sophistication that defines the Faena experience. 

 

In this role, you will ensure vendors are paid on time, invoices are impeccably processed, and all financial interactions uphold our brand’s commitment to excellence. You’re not just managing payables — you’re safeguarding trust, supporting operational brilliance, and contributing to the seamless magic that powers Faena behind the scenes. 
 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Coordinate with Purchasing, Receiving, and department leaders to ensure all invoices and Purchase Orders are accurately collected, verified, and entered into the financial system. 

  • Match invoices against approved POs and receiving documentation to confirm accuracy before posting to Accounts Payable. 

  • Track payment due dates and process approved payments in alignment with Faena financial policies and vendor agreements. 

  • Maintain a structured, compliant filing system for all invoices, PO documentation, and receipts in both physical and digital formats. 

  • Proactively investigate discrepancies between supplier invoices and received goods or services to prevent delays and disputes. 

  • Handle supplier inquiries with professionalism, providing timely resolutions and reinforcing Faena as a trusted, high‑quality hospitality partner. 

  • Liaise with vendors to document follow‑ups, explanations, and outcomes, ensuring clear audit trails and transparency. 

  • Reconcile vendor statements with internal records to ensure payables remain current, accurate, and audit‑ready. 

  • Prepare regular AP reports — including aging summaries and variance analysis — to support finance leadership and strategic planning. 

  • Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation, clarity, and accurate records. 

  • Maintain impeccable audit trails and ensure all payment activities conform to Faena and corporate finance standards. 

  • Execute responsibilities within established SOPs, financial protocols, and Faena brand standards, ensuring consistency and operational excellence. 

  • Partner with Purchasing, Cost Control, Receiving, and Operations to maintain alignment on payment cycles, contract compliance, and budget considerations. 

  • Ensure invoices and POs are properly validated, coded, and approved by relevant HODs before processing. 

  • Continuously seek opportunities to enhance AP efficiency, accuracy, and innovation. 

  • Uphold all Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards, fostering a culture of responsibility and refinement in every financial interaction. 

  • Perform additional duties or tasks as requested by leadership with discretion, professionalism, and commitment to excellence.

The Chief Accountant oversees daily accounting operations, ensuring accurate financial reporting, compliance, and effective financial controls. The role manages general ledger activities, reconciliations, budgeting support, tax compliance, and financial closing processes while maintaining accurate records and supporting audits. The Chief Accountant also supervises the accounting team and provides financial insights to support business operations and decision-making

  • Maintain compliance with accounting standards (e.g., IFRS) and company policies 

  • Supervise and support the accounting team in daily operations 

  • Reconcile bank accounts and balance sheet accounts regularly 

  • Monitor cash flow, expenses, and financial transactions 

  • Ensure accurate recording and classification of financial data 

  • Coordinate and support internal and external audits 

  • Prepare tax reports and ensure timely filing and compliance 

  • Develop and implement internal controls to safeguard company assets 

  • Review payroll accounting and related financial entries 

  • Assist in budgeting and forecasting processes 

  • Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies and issues 

  • Ensure proper documentation and record-keeping of all financial transactions

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW 

The Credit Manager is responsible for overseeing the organization’s credit operations, ensuring effective credit control, timely collection of outstanding payments, and minimizing financial risk. The role involves evaluating customer creditworthiness, monitoring accounts receivable, maintaining strong client relationships, and ensuring compliance with company credit policies and financial procedures. The Credit Manager also supports cash flow management, prepares credit reports, and works closely with finance and sales teams to improve collection efficiency and maintain healthy financial performance. 
 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Oversee daily credit control and accounts receivable operations 

  • Evaluate customer credit applications and assess creditworthiness 

  • Approve or recommend credit limits based on financial analysis 

  • Monitor outstanding balances and ensure timely collections 

  • Follow up on overdue accounts and resolve payment issues 

  • Prepare aging reports, credit reports, and collection summaries 

  • Maintain accurate customer credit records and documentation 

  • Minimize bad debts and reduce financial risk to the organization 

  • Ensure compliance with company credit policies and procedures 

  • Coordinate with sales, finance, and customer service teams regarding account issues 

  • Negotiate payment plans and settlement arrangements when necessary 

  • Reconcile customer accounts and investigate discrepancies 

  • Support month-end closing and financial reporting activities 

  • Monitor cash flow related to receivables and collections 

  • Conduct regular reviews of customer accounts and credit limits 

  • Assist with audits and ensure proper internal controls are maintained 

  • Train and supervise credit and collection staff when applicable 

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and stakeholders

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field 

  • Professional certifications such as CPA, CMA, ACCA, or Credit Management certifications are an advantage 

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in credit control, accounts receivable, or finance management 

  • Strong knowledge of credit policies, collections, and financial analysis 

  • Understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting 

  • Experience with ERP and accounting systems such as SAP, Oracle NetSuite, or Microsoft Excel 

  • Knowledge of risk assessment and debt recovery procedures

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Assistant Director of Sales – Government & Royal Affairs supports the Director of Sales in driving the hotel’s commercial strategy and revenue performance, with a primary focus on Government, Royal Affairs, Diplomatic, and strategic institutional accounts across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

The role is responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with key government entities, royal offices, ministries, authorities, embassies, diplomatic missions, government-related organizations, and strategic decision-makers. The Assistant Director of Sales will identify and convert high-value business opportunities while ensuring the hotel is positioned as a preferred destination for government, royal, diplomatic, VIP, corporate, MICE, and high-profile events.

Working closely with the Director of Sales and the wider Commercial team, the role will lead day-to-day sales activities, account development, prospecting, relationship management, contract negotiations, and business conversion within the assigned market.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the Director of Sales in developing and executing the hotel’s annual Government & Royal Affairs sales strategy, business plan, account plans, and revenue objectives.

  • Take ownership of the day-to-day development and management of key government, royal, diplomatic, and strategic institutional accounts.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with ministries, government authorities, royal offices, government entities, sovereign and strategic organizations, embassies, diplomatic missions, and government-related companies.

  • Identify key decision-makers and influencers within target organizations and establish long-term commercial relationships at senior levels.

  • Proactively identify new government and institutional business opportunities and develop strategies to convert them into long-term and recurring revenue.

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of government, royal, diplomatic, VIP, corporate, MICE, and strategic account opportunities.

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of high-value accounts while ensuring regular account reviews, production tracking, action plans, and revenue development.

  • Develop strategic account plans for key government and royal accounts, including business potential, production history, contacts, opportunities, competitor positioning, and future business forecasts.

  • Identify opportunities for VIP stays, government delegations, official visits, diplomatic travel, executive accommodation, long stays, meetings, conferences, state-related events, private functions, and exclusive hotel buyouts.

  • Lead and support negotiations for government rates, preferred agreements, corporate agreements, long-stay arrangements, accommodation contracts, event agreements, and strategic partnerships, ensuring commercial value and compliance with hotel policies.

  • Maintain a thorough understanding of government procurement processes, tender opportunities, preferred supplier requirements, and relevant business practices within the Saudi market.

  • Proactively monitor government calendars, major national initiatives, international delegations, conferences, exhibitions, summits, sporting events, entertainment programs, and other major events that may generate hotel demand.

  • Develop strong relationships with protocol teams, executive assistants, procurement departments, travel coordinators, event organizers, government representatives, diplomatic personnel, and other key stakeholders.

  • Conduct regular sales calls, executive meetings, presentations, client visits, site inspections, familiarization visits, client entertainment, and relationship-building activities.

  • Coordinate and host high-profile government, royal, diplomatic, and VIP clients during hotel visits and ensure that their requirements are communicated effectively to all relevant departments.

  • Work closely with Operations, Front Office, Guest Relations, Events, Security, Reservations, and other departments to ensure seamless delivery of VIP, government, royal, and diplomatic stays and events.

  • Ensure all business generated through government and strategic accounts is accurately handed over to the relevant operational teams with clear requirements, expectations, and timelines.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date account information, contacts, activities, opportunities, pipelines, production, contracts, and account plans.

  • Monitor account production and performance against agreed targets, identifying gaps and implementing corrective action where required.

  • Support the Director of Sales in leading, coaching, and developing the Sales team, sharing government market knowledge and ensuring a disciplined and proactive approach to account management and business development.

  • Work collaboratively with all Commercial and operational departments to ensure the hotel delivers a consistent, discreet, and exceptional experience for government, royal, diplomatic, and VIP guests.

  • Maintain the highest standards of confidentiality, discretion, professionalism, integrity, and relationship management when dealing with government, royal, diplomatic, and high-profile clients.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Maintenance Engineer – Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, schedule, and oversee planned preventive maintenance (PPM) and corrective/unplanned maintenance activities for electrical, mechanical, and electromechanical systems, machinery, and equipment.
  • Monitor the condition and performance of machines and equipment to identify potential failures and minimize unexpected breakdowns and operational downtime.
  • Lead troubleshooting, fault diagnosis, and repair activities for electrical, mechanical, and control system issues.
  • Participate in new machinery installation, commissioning, testing, and production transfer projects, ensuring proper maintenance requirements and technical standards are established from the beginning.
  • Take an active role in machine construction, modification, overhaul, refurbishment, and revision activities.
  • Develop and maintain preventive maintenance schedules, checklists, technical procedures, and maintenance standards for all assigned equipment.
  • Analyze recurring equipment failures and conduct root cause analysis (RCA) to identify corrective actions and prevent recurrence.
  • Lead problem-solving and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving equipment reliability, efficiency, safety, and maintenance performance.
  • Coordinate with Production and other operational departments to plan maintenance activities while minimizing disruption to operations.
  • Manage and maintain accurate maintenance records, equipment history, work orders, breakdown reports, and technical documentation.
  • Support the development and implementation of maintenance KPIs, including equipment availability, downtime, breakdown frequency, preventive maintenance completion, and maintenance response time.
  • Manage spare parts and maintenance materials, including stock monitoring, critical spare identification, minimum stock levels, and timely replenishment.
  • Review technical specifications and support the selection and procurement of spare parts, tools, equipment, and maintenance services.
  • Coordinate and supervise external contractors and service providers during specialized maintenance, inspections, repairs, and equipment servicing.
  • Ensure all maintenance activities are carried out in compliance with health, safety, environmental, and company requirements.
  • Conduct regular inspections of machinery, equipment, electrical systems, and mechanical installations to ensure safe and reliable operation.
  • Assist in preparing maintenance budgets, annual maintenance plans, and equipment replacement or capital expenditure proposals.
  • Review equipment manuals, technical drawings, electrical diagrams, and manufacturer recommendations to ensure proper maintenance and repair practices.
  • Support the implementation and improvement of Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) and ensure maintenance data is accurately recorded and updated.
  • Train, guide, and support maintenance technicians and team members in proper troubleshooting, repair, preventive maintenance, and safe working practices.
  • Ensure that all maintenance activities are properly documented and completed within the required timeframe.
  • Participate in equipment performance reviews, reliability improvement programs, and energy-efficiency initiatives.
  • Maintain an adequate level of technical readiness to respond to urgent breakdowns and critical equipment failures.
  • Recommend technical improvements, equipment upgrades, and process modifications to enhance reliability, productivity, energy efficiency, and operational performance.
  • Perform any other maintenance and engineering responsibilities as assigned by management.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in maintenance engineering.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical, mechanical, and electromechanical systems.
  • Experience in preventive, corrective, and emergency maintenance.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.

  • Knowledge of spare parts management and maintenance documentation.

jobDescription.text:
To lead the Finance Team in all financial aspects of the hotel’s operations, to ensure that all local & corporate policies & procedures are observed, and to supervise the day-to-day operations of the Finance office. We are looking for an experienced Director of Finance to oversee all financial aspects of business and drive the company’s financial strategy and planning.

You will be responsible for:

1. Financial Management

  • Budgeting: Develop and manage the hotel’s annual budget.
  • Financial Reporting: Prepare and present financial statements and reports to senior management.
  • Forecasting: Analyze financial performance and provide forecasts to inform strategic decisions.

2. Operational Support

  • Business Analysis: Support operational teams by providing financial insights and analysis to enhance performance.
  • Cost Control: Implement cost control measures to maintain profitability.

3. Compliance and Risk Management

  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure adherence to financial regulations and standards.
  • Risk Assessment: Identify and manage financial risks associated with hotel operations.

4. Team Leadership

  • Staff Management: Lead and develop the finance team, fostering a collaborative environment.
  • Training: Provide training and support to staff on financial processes and systems.

5. Strategic Planning

  • Business Development: Collaborate with other departments to identify opportunities for revenue growth.
  • Investment Analysis: Evaluate potential investment opportunities and their financial implications.

6. Communication

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate financial performance and strategies to stakeholders, including owners and management.
  • Cross-Department Collaboration: Work closely with other departments to ensure alignment on financial objectives.
  • These functions contribute to the overall financial health and operational efficiency of the hotel, ensuring it meets both short-term and long-term goals.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  1. Directs, coordinates, and participates in all activities of Accounting personnel, such as:
  • preparing management reports, financial statements, and related accounting reports;
  • receiving, storing, issuing, accounting for, and controlling the cost of food, beverage, general supplies, operating equipment, and fixed assets;
  • requisition needed equipment, materials, and supplies;
  • receiving, keeping, depositing, investing, and disbursing funds;
  • preparing, controlling, and maintaining all vouchers and cheques;
  • processing and preparing all credit applications;
  • auditing all revenue reports of the hotel;
  1. Ensures that all accounting reports and financial statements are prepared according to the uniform system of accounts for the hotel.
  2. Sees to the accurate and timely preparation and submission of all accounting reports, financial statements, and tax returns.
  3. Complies in conjunction with the mgt. Department heads are responsible for all budgets and forecasts covering all hotel activities, and maintain all budget control procedures.
  4. Analyzes and interprets financial statements and accounting reports of the hotel; reports to management.
  5. Maintains all proper control systems and procedures and conducts continuous audit of all hotel accounts, records, and transactions.
  6. Implements and administers credit and collection policies and procedures established by the General Manager.
  7. Ensures the maintenance of ledgers and subsidiary records of authorized appropriations and expenditures are properly authorized and accounted for.
  8. Ensures the maintenance of all subsidiary records in connection with inventories, accounts receivables, accounts payables, operating equipment, fixed assets, etc.
  9. Supervises and directs the receiving, storing, and issuing functions to ensure that proper procedures and controls are in effect.
  10. Assists all department heads in the preparation of their respective budgets and feasibility studies, and whenever any financial information or expertise is required.
  11. Ensures the cleanliness and maintenance of all accounting machines and equipment.
  12. Maintains good relations with banks to facilitate the handling of such arrangements as overdrafts, placing funds in time deposits, etc.
  13. Maintains good relationships with the government to facilitate the handling of such hotel functions as tax matters, import licenses, and customs clearances.
  14. Performs related duties as assigned.

  • Manage kitchen inventory, track food costs, and implement cost control measures to optimize operational efficiency and profitability

qualifications.title: Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience supervising and leading kitchen staff in high-volume food service environments
  • Strong proficiency in inventory management, food cost analysis, and budget control to drive operational efficiency
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to multitask effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop team members

  • Familiarity with catering management software and modern kitchen equipment (preferred)
  • Ability to work flexible schedules, including early mornings, evenings, and peak service hours
  • Culinary certification or formal culinary training from a recognized institution (preferred)

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and composure under pressure during high-demand service periods
  • Passion for culinary excellence, continuous learning, and staying current with culinary trends and techniques

  • Understanding of local Saudi Arabian food regulations and cultural dietary considerations

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW 

The Security Supervisor is responsible for overseeing day-to-day security operations at FAENA, ensuring the safety of guests, employees, and resort assets. The role supervises security officers, monitors patrols and surveillance systems, responds to incidents, and enforces safety procedures while maintaining a discreet, professional approach aligned with ultra-luxury hospitality standards. 

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Supervise daily security operations across assigned resort areas.  

  • Lead and monitor security officers during patrols, shifts, and post assignments.  

  • Ensure all access points, entrances, and restricted areas are properly controlled.  

  • Monitor CCTV systems, alarm systems, and security equipment to detect and respond to incidents.  

  • Respond promptly to security incidents, disturbances, and emergencies.  

  • Report and document incidents accurately and escalate issues to the Security Manager when necessary.  

  • Conduct regular inspections of resort premises to identify safety or security risks.  

  • Enforce resort security policies, procedures, and access control standards.  

  • Assist in managing VIP guest security arrangements when required.  

  • Support crowd control and safety measures during events, peak periods, and special operations.  

  • Coordinate with Front Office, Engineering, Housekeeping, and other departments for operational security needs.  

  • Ensure proper handover between shifts and maintain accurate logbook records.  

  • Conduct toolbox talks and briefings for security staff at the start of shifts.  

  • Ensure all security personnel are properly groomed, trained, and following standards.  

  • Assist in emergency response situations, including evacuations and drills.  

  • Monitor contractor, vendor, and visitor access to ensure compliance with security procedures.  

  • Maintain confidentiality and professionalism in all guest and operational matters.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
QUALIFICATIONS DESIRED 

  • High school diploma required; diploma or degree in Security Management, Criminology, or related field preferred. 

  • 3–5 years of experience in security operations, preferably in hospitality, luxury hotels, or large-scale resorts. 

  • Prior experience in a supervisory security role is highly preferred. 

  • Basic certifications in first aid, fire safety, or emergency response are an advantage. 

  • Knowledge of CCTV systems, access control, and security procedures. 

  • Familiarity with local safety regulations and compliance standards. 

  • Proficiency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
SKILLS 

  • Strong leadership and ability to supervise and guide security teams. 

  • Excellent observation and situational awareness skills. 

  • Ability to respond quickly and effectively to incidents and emergencies. 

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 

  • Good report writing and documentation abilities. 

  • Ability to remain calm and make decisions under pressure. 

  • Strong problem-solving and conflict management skills. 

  • High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism. 

  • Ability to enforce policies firmly while maintaining guest-focused service standards. 

  • Strong teamwork and coordination with multiple departments. 

  • Physical fitness and ability to perform patrol duties when required. 

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT 

  • Endure various physical movements throughout the work areas 

  • Ability to move safely in uneven terrain or in confined spaces 

  • Remain active, constantly moving, or prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer throughout work shift 

  • Medium Work: Exerting up to 20kg of force occasionally, and/or 10kg of force frequently, and/or up to 5kg of constantly moving objects, may occasionally lift and/or move up to 15kg

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Shift Supervision & Post Control

• Lead assigned Security colleagues during the shift, ensuring correct deployment, punctuality, grooming, equipment readiness, and clear pre- and post-shift briefings.

• Supervise daily Security operations across assigned posts, including Control Room, lobby, loading bay, back-of-house, colleague entrance, visitor access, VIP parking, guest floors, outdoor areas, and patrol zones.

• Ensure essential company-issued equipment such as radio / communication device, torchlight, pocket mask, keys, passes, and first-aid items are available, controlled, and used properly.

• Conduct regular checks on Security colleagues and posts to confirm vigilance, adherence to standards, and effective handover.

Access, Patrols & Guest Safety

• Manage access points to ensure all colleagues, casual labour, vendors, contractors, suppliers, visitors, and vehicles enter through authorized channels.

• Maintain vigilance at pass counters and support the Visitor Management System, contractor controls, vehicle checks, and delivery access procedures.

• Perform roving safety and security patrols within and around the resort, including guest areas, heart-of-house, accommodation / service areas where applicable, and external resort surroundings.

• Identify fire hazards, unsafe acts, suspicious behaviour, breaches of procedure, or maintenance risks and take immediate corrective or escalation action.

Control Room, CCTV & Systems

• Be in charge of the Hotel Security Control Room during the shift and ensure all official documents are handled accurately according to SOP.

• Monitor CCTV coverage, alarms, access control, duress systems, fire-life-safety alerts, and security equipment, highlighting faults or unusual observations immediately.

• Support preliminary CCTV review for investigation and training purposes in accordance with privacy and evidence-handling standards.

• Coordinate with Engineering, IT, or relevant departments to report system faults, door lock issues, safe box concerns, and security equipment defects.

Emergency Response & Incident Reporting

• Respond to security, medical, fire, duress, lost child, crowd control, guest concern, suspicious activity, and other emergencies as quickly as possible.

• Perform First Aid / CPR / AED where trained and required, and coordinate with internal and external emergency responders.

• Gather facts, document incidents, prepare end-of-shift reports, complete accident / incident forms, and maintain accurate logbook entries.

• Handle lost and found reports, key and pass inventory, safe box issues, door lock concerns, lift control, VIP movement support, crowd control, and ushering duties as assigned.

Team Support & Compliance

• Coach Security Officers and CCTV colleagues on post standards, report writing, guest interaction, emergency procedures, and professional conduct.

  • • Ensure all activities comply with hotel policies, security protocols, confidentiality standards, Saudi regulations, and brand expectations.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Director of Sales & Marketing to lead the commercial strategy of a large-scale hotel operation in Makkah, with a primary focus on the Hajj and Umrah markets, religious tourism, individual travelers, and group business.

The Director of Sales & Marketing will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to maximize occupancy, revenue, market share, and profitability throughout the Hajj and Umrah seasons.

The successful candidate will have strong knowledge of the Makkah hospitality and religious tourism market, with an established understanding of Umrah operators, Hajj missions, travel agencies, tour operators, wholesalers, and key international source markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement short-term and long-term sales and marketing strategies with a strong focus on Hajj, Umrah, religious tourism, individual travelers, and group business.
  • Establish measurable sales targets, KPIs, and action plans for the Sales & Marketing team.
  • Drive business from key Hajj and Umrah source markets and continuously identify opportunities to expand the hotel's geographical market reach.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with Umrah operators, Hajj missions, travel agencies, tour operators, wholesalers, group organizers, and other key partners.
  • Identify and secure new group and individual Umrah business while strengthening relationships with existing high-producing accounts.
  • Develop specific commercial strategies for Hajj, Ramadan, peak Umrah periods, and other key religious seasons.
  • Conduct regular market research and competitor analysis to understand demand patterns, pricing, market positioning, and emerging opportunities.
  • Monitor competitor hotels, market trends, group movements, and Hajj and Umrah demand to recommend timely commercial actions.
  • Work closely with Revenue Management to optimize pricing, inventory, length of stay, group allocation, market segmentation, and business mix.
  • Evaluate group requests and business opportunities based on revenue potential, profitability, displacement, and overall hotel strategy.
  • Develop and manage the annual Sales & Marketing budget and commercial action plan.
  • Analyze the return on investment of sales trips, international roadshows, trade events, marketing campaigns, and business development activities.
  • Conduct regular sales missions and business development activities in strategic domestic and international source markets.
  • Represent the hotel at relevant Hajj and Umrah exhibitions, travel trade events, workshops, roadshows, and networking opportunities.
  • Maintain close relationships with key decision-makers and partners within the religious tourism sector.
  • Monitor account production, room nights, average rates, revenue contribution, conversion, and overall account performance.
  • Identify underperforming accounts and markets and implement corrective commercial action plans.
  • Develop strategies to increase direct and individual Umrah bookings alongside contracted group business.
  • Work closely with Revenue, Reservations, Front Office, Finance, and Operations to ensure commercial commitments and group requirements are effectively delivered.
  • Ensure contracts, rates, allocations, payment terms, and commercial agreements are properly managed and aligned with hotel objectives.
  • Prepare regular commercial reports, forecasts, market intelligence, and performance analysis for hotel leadership.
  • Lead, coach, motivate, and develop the Sales & Marketing team to maintain a strong performance and accountability culture.
  • Ensure all Sales & Marketing activities comply with Accor brand standards, commercial guidelines, policies, and procedures.

Key Competencies

  • Hajj & Umrah Market Expertise
  • Religious Tourism Sales
  • Group & Individual Business Development
  • Strategic Commercial Planning
  • Key Account Management
  • Revenue & Profitability Focus
  • Market Intelligence & Competitor Analysis
  • Contract Negotiation
  • Leadership & Team Development
  • International Market Development
  • Data-Driven Decision-Making
  • Stakeholder & Partner Relationship Management

qualifications.title: Qualifications

  • Established understanding of Umrah operators, Hajj missions, travel agencies, tour operators, wholesalers, and group business.
  • Strong knowledge of major domestic and international source markets for Hajj and Umrah.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, excellence starts at the source. As a Butcher, you will play an important role in supporting our culinary operations by preparing premium meat products to the highest standards of quality, precision, freshness, and presentation.

Working closely with the Sous Chef and wider culinary team, you will be responsible for cutting, trimming, deboning, portioning, and preparing a variety of meat products according to established specifications and operational requirements. Your craftsmanship and attention to detail will contribute to the consistency and quality of dishes across our culinary outlets.

From receiving and inspecting meat deliveries to maintaining proper storage, mise en place, hygiene, and food safety standards, your contribution will support an efficient kitchen operation and exceptional dining experiences at SLS The Red Sea.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cut, trim, debone, grind, portion, and prepare a variety of meat products according to established specifications and quality standards.
  • Prepare and portion meat products to ensure consistency in quality, size, weight, and presentation across kitchen operations.
  • Receive and inspect meat deliveries, ensuring product quality, freshness, temperature, and specification compliance.
  • Package, label, store, and rotate meat products correctly to maintain freshness, quality, and food safety.
  • Maintain daily mise en place and ensure all required products are prepared and ready for service.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and hygienic workstations, tools, and equipment to prevent cross-contamination.
  • Follow HACCP, food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and applicable health and safety requirements at all times.
  • Monitor product quality and report any food safety concerns, equipment issues, or product discrepancies to the appropriate supervisor.
  • Monitor stock levels and communicate product requirements or shortages to the culinary team in a timely manner.
  • Minimize food waste through efficient cutting, portioning, trimming, storage, and responsible use of ingredients.
  • Support other culinary areas when required, contributing to smooth and efficient kitchen operations.
  • Use butchery equipment safely and responsibly, following established operating procedures and training guidelines.
  • Participate in training and development opportunities to enhance butchery techniques, product knowledge, and culinary skills.
  • Work collaboratively with the Sous Chef, Chef de Cuisine, and wider culinary team to support seamless service and consistent food quality.
  • Maintain a professional, respectful, and positive working environment aligned with the values and standards of SLS The Red Sea.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Formal culinary training or a Certificate/Diploma from a recognized culinary institution is preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant butchery experience, ideally within a hotel, luxury resort, high-end restaurant, or professional food production environment.
  • Strong knowledge of meat preparation, butchery techniques, kitchen operations, food safety, and hygiene standards.
  • Good knowledge of butchery tools, equipment, and safe handling practices.
  • Strong attention to detail with good organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure and maintain consistent quality in a fast-paced kitchen environment.
  • Ability to follow instructions accurately and work effectively as part of a diverse culinary team.
  • Flexible to work varied shifts, including weekends and holidays, according to business requirements.
  • Passion for food quality, craftsmanship, and delivering exceptional dining experiences.
