jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW 

Yoga Nidra/ Meditation/ Qigong/ Tai Chi instructor is a wellness professional responsible for designing and leading classes or individual sessions that guide guests through movement, breathing, and meditation practices to improve their physical health, mental clarity, and overall well-being. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Lead safe, engaging classes tailored to various skill levels, providing clear instructions, demonstrations, and modifications for poses or movements. 

  • Ensure a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment, applying knowledge of anatomy and proper alignment principles to prevent injuries and address individual limitations or health conditions. 

  • Plan and execute class sequences and programs that incorporate warm-ups, main practices (poses, movements, breathing, meditation), and cool-downs/relaxation stages. 

  • Build positive relationships with clients, providing individualized attention, feedback, and motivation to support their progress and goals. 

  • Educate clients on the philosophy and principles of the practices (e.g., the chakra system, Meridian/Vayu energy mapping, mindfulness) to promote a holistic approach to health. 

  • Manage class logistics, including scheduling, attendance records, and potentially marketing or business development efforts. 

  • Professional Development: Stay current on industry trends and best practices through ongoing education, workshops, and maintaining personal practice and certifications.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
QUALIFICATIONS DESIRED 

  • Relevant professional certification from a recognized organization (e.g., Yoga Alliance for Yoga, NQA for Qigong, or a certified Tai Chi for Health program) is required. 

  • Previous experience in teaching the specific modalities preferred, with a minimum two years of experience. 

  • Strong understanding of human anatomy, physiology, and the principles of the specific practices. 

  • Proficiency with virtual teaching platforms and technical setup for online classes is increasingly valuable. 

  • CPR and First Aid certification it’s a plus.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
SKILLS 

  • Team-oriented with excellent time management 

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 

  • A calm, encouraging, and empathetic personality. 

  • Ability to motivate and inspire participants of diverse backgrounds and ages. 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT 

  • Endure various physical movements throughout the work areas 

  • Ability to move safely in uneven terrain or in confined spaces 

  • Remain active, constantly moving, or prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer throughout work shift 

  • Physical fitness and the ability to perform and demonstrate movements proficiently.

A Spa Attendant ensures a clean, comfortable, and welcoming spa environment by managing cleanliness, restocking supplies, assisting guests with robes and directions, handling basic inquiries/bookings, and supporting therapists and reception; key duties include maintaining locker rooms, laundry, and guest orientation, requiring excellent customer service, multitasking, and stamina for a fast-paced setting.

  • Administrative Tasks: Handle basic phone inquiries, manage simple bookings or rescheduling, and process payments. 

  • Inventory: Assist with stock control for linens, consumables, and retail items.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, every memorable dining experience begins before the guest arrives at the table. As an F&B Reservations Agent, you will be the first point of connection for guests planning their dining experience — handling reservations with accuracy, warmth, and the distinctive personality of SLS.

From recommending the right venue and responding to guest enquiries to managing bookings and capturing individual preferences, you will work closely with our F&B teams to ensure every reservation is thoughtfully coordinated and every guest arrives feeling expected and welcomed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle restaurant reservations through phone, email, and designated reservation systems in a professional and timely manner.
  • Respond to guest enquiries and provide accurate information about dining venues, menus, operating hours, promotions, and available experiences.
  • Manage new reservations, amendments, cancellations, and special requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Maintain accurate reservation records, guest profiles, preferences, and relevant notes to support personalized service.
  • Communicate clearly with guests and confirm reservation details to ensure a smooth dining experience.
  • Coordinate closely with restaurant and F&B teams regarding reservations, special occasions, guest preferences, and operational requirements.
  • Handle guest requests, enquiries, and concerns professionally, ensuring appropriate follow-up when required.
  • Support effective table and reservation management to maximize restaurant occupancy and revenue opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to recommend suitable dining experiences and promotions based on guest preferences.
  • Maintain clear and professional communication across all guest interactions, reflecting SLS service standards.
  • Ensure guest information and reservation details are handled accurately and confidentially.
  • Stay updated on restaurant concepts, menus, promotions, special events, and relevant hotel experiences.
  • Follow departmental procedures, service standards, and reservation policies at all times.
  • Support the wider F&B team with reservation-related tasks and operational requirements when needed.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• High School Diploma or equivalent; a qualification in Hospitality or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Reservations, Guest Relations, Front Office, F&B Operations, or a similar guest-facing role.
  • Good command of spoken and written English is required.
  • Strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills with a warm and professional approach.
  • Basic computer skills and familiarity with restaurant reservation systems; experience with POS systems is an advantage.
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy when managing reservations and guest information.
  • Ability to manage multiple enquiries and reservations efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional and guest-focused, with a genuine interest in creating seamless dining experiences.
  • Previous experience within a luxury or lifestyle hospitality environment is an advantage.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, every dining experience is an opportunity to inspire, surprise, and delight. As a Commis I – Lobby Lounge, you will play an important role in supporting the culinary team in delivering exceptional food experiences that reflect the creativity, quality, and distinctive character of SLS.

Working closely with the Chef de Partie and the wider culinary team, you will support daily food preparation and service within the Lobby Lounge, ensuring that ingredients are handled with care and dishes are prepared and presented to the highest standards.

From daily mise en place and food preparation to supporting service and maintaining a clean and organized workstation, your contribution will help create memorable dining experiences while ensuring consistency, efficiency, and adherence to the highest standards of food safety and hygiene.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and assist in the execution of high-quality dishes in accordance with established recipes, culinary standards, and instructions from senior chefs.
  • Complete daily mise en place and ensure the assigned workstation is fully prepared, organized, clean, and adequately stocked throughout service.
  • Assist with the preparation, handling, and portioning of ingredients to ensure freshness, quality, and consistency.
  • Support the Chef de Partie and Demi Chef de Partie during service to ensure timely, efficient, and consistent execution.
  • Follow established recipes, preparation methods, portion control guidelines, and presentation standards to maintain consistency across all dishes.
  • Handle, store, label, and rotate food products correctly in accordance with food safety and quality standards.
  • Maintain high standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and personal grooming, ensuring compliance with HACCP and applicable health and safety regulations.
  • Use kitchen equipment safely and responsibly, reporting any faults, damage, or maintenance requirements promptly to the appropriate senior chef.
  • Support initiatives to minimize food waste through proper preparation, storage, portion control, and efficient use of ingredients.
  • Participate in cleaning schedules and ensure workstations, equipment, utensils, and kitchen areas are maintained to the required standards.
  • Actively participate in training and development opportunities to enhance culinary skills, product knowledge, and kitchen practices.
  • Work collaboratively with the culinary team, demonstrating professionalism, a positive attitude, attention to detail, and a genuine willingness to learn while contributing to an exceptional Lobby Lounge dining experience.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• A Certificate or Diploma in Culinary Arts from a recognized culinary institution is preferred.
  • Minimum of 1–2 years of relevant kitchen experience, ideally within a 4- or 5-star hotel or upscale dining environment.
  • Basic knowledge of food preparation techniques, kitchen equipment, and daily culinary operations.
  • Good understanding of food safety, hygiene practices, and HACCP standards.
  • Ability to follow instructions, work efficiently under pressure, and maintain consistency in a fast-paced kitchen environment.
  • Strong commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and delivering memorable dining experiences

jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, our Concierge team is at the heart of connecting guests with everything the destination has to offer. As a Concierge Agent, you will be a trusted advisor throughout the guest journey, providing personalized recommendations, coordinating reservations and transportation, and helping guests discover experiences across the hotel, Shura Island, and the wider Red Sea destination.

With a warm and engaging approach, you will take the time to understand each guest’s preferences and turn their requests into thoughtful, seamless arrangements. Working closely with hotel teams and destination partners, you will ensure every recommendation, reservation, and special request is handled with care, accuracy, and the distinctive spirit of SLS The Red Sea.

Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome guests warmly upon arrival, remain engaged throughout their stay, and ensure a personalized and memorable experience.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for guest inquiries, requests, and arrangements, delivering prompt, polished, and attentive service.
  • Understand guest preferences and special requests to provide thoughtful recommendations and personalized experiences.
  • Handle and coordinate reservations for restaurants, transportation, activities, entertainment, spa, wellness, and other guest experiences.
  • Create and recommend personalized activities and experiences based on individual guest preferences and interests.
  • Assist guests in planning their stay by providing recommendations and coordinating arrangements from initial request through completion.
  • Develop and maintain up-to-date knowledge of Shura Island and the wider Red Sea destination, including hotels, dining venues, attractions, activities, transportation, and guest experiences.
  • Confidently guide guests through available experiences across the destination and provide relevant recommendations based on their preferences.
  • Build and maintain professional relationships with trusted partners and service providers to support seamless guest arrangements.
  • Arrange and confirm transportation, including airport transfers, private drivers, taxis, and other guest mobility requirements.
  • Coordinate closely with Bell Desk and Valet teams to ensure smooth and seamless guest arrivals and departures.
  • Assist with personal arrangements and special requests, ensuring each request is handled with discretion, accuracy, and attention to detail.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, every guest journey is shaped by the moments that feel effortless, personal, and unforgettable. As a Duty Manager, you will be a visible leader and ambassador of the hotel, ensuring exceptional guest experiences, smooth Front Office operations, and seamless coordination across departments.

Representing hotel leadership during your shift, you will combine a strong presence in the lobby with confident decision-making, hands-on team leadership, and genuine guest engagement. From welcoming VIPs and resolving guest concerns to overseeing Front Office operations and responding to unexpected situations, you will ensure every moment reflects the bold, vibrant, and guest-centric spirit of SLS.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain a visible leadership presence in the lobby, actively engaging with guests and supporting the Front Office team throughout the shift.
  • Welcome and engage with VIPs, regular guests, and loyalty members, ensuring preferences are recognized and experiences are personalized.
  • Handle guest feedback, concerns, and complaints promptly and professionally, ensuring appropriate resolution, follow-up, and documentation.
  • Oversee smooth and efficient check-in and check-out experiences, room allocation, and the handling of groups and VIP arrivals.
  • Take full ownership of Duty Manager shifts, acting as the senior operational decision-maker during non-office hours when required.
  • Supervise Front Office operations, ensuring consistent adherence to SOPs, SLS brand standards, and service guidelines.
  • Coordinate closely with Housekeeping, Engineering, Security, and other departments to resolve operational and guest-related matters efficiently.
  • Monitor room status, Out of Order rooms, and operational updates to ensure accurate and seamless communication between departments.
  • Respond to and accurately document incidents, accidents, emergencies, and other significant operational matters in accordance with hotel procedures.
  • Lead daily briefings and ensure clear, effective, and action-oriented shift handovers.
  • Coach, guide, and develop Front Office colleagues through ongoing feedback, task delegation, training, and on-the-job support.
  • Monitor team performance and contribute to performance reviews and colleague development.
  • Ensure Front Office colleagues are confident in cashiering, reservations, upselling, check-in/out procedures, complaint handling, and emergency response.
  • Oversee cashiering and cash-handling activities during the shift, ensuring accuracy and compliance with hotel policies.
  • Authorize adjustments, paid-outs, and operational exceptions within approved limits, escalating when required.
  • Monitor guest accounts, open folios, Paymasters, and billing discrepancies, coordinating with Finance when necessary.
  • Support revenue initiatives, including room upselling and other Front Office opportunities, while encouraging team participation.
  • Assist with team rosters, attendance management, and labor planning in line with operational requirements and business volumes.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of hotel emergency procedures and lead calm, effective responses when required.
  • Work closely with Security & Safety to maintain a safe and secure environment for guests, colleagues, and hotel assets.
  • Ensure guest confidentiality, data privacy, and security standards are consistently maintained.
  • Promote a positive culture of ownership, collaboration, and exceptional guest service across the Front Office team.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a supervisory Front Office role within an upscale, luxury, or lifestyle hotel.
  • Previous experience as a Duty Manager or Night Manager is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of Front Office operations, guest services, reservations, cashiering, credit procedures, and room management.
  • Proficiency in Opera PMS and Microsoft Office.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to guide, motivate, and support a diverse team.
  • Excellent guest relations, interpersonal, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Excellent command of spoken and written English is essential.
  • Calm and decisive under pressure, with a proactive and solution-focused approach.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple operational priorities.
  • Previous experience within a luxury or lifestyle hospitality environment is highly desirable.

At SLS The Red Sea, the guest experience begins before they even step through the door. As a Doorman, you will be one of the first faces our guests meet — setting the tone with a warm welcome, confident presence, and genuine SLS personality.

  • Open and close vehicle doors while ensuring a seamless and attentive arrival experience.
  • Assist guests with luggage when required and coordinate closely with the Bell team.

  • Maintain a polished, professional, and welcoming appearance in line with SLS grooming and service standards.
  • Follow hotel safety, security, and operational procedures at all times.

qualifications.title: Qualifications

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, every interaction is an opportunity to create a memorable guest experience. As a Guest Service Centre Agent, you will be a central point of connection between our guests and the hotel — delivering warm, confident, and seamless communication while ensuring every request is handled with care, efficiency, and the distinctive personality of SLS.

From assisting with guest inquiries and coordinating service requests to providing hotel information and supporting communication across departments, you will play an essential role in making the guest journey effortless. With attention to detail, strong communication, and a genuine passion for hospitality, you will ensure every interaction reflects the bold, elevated, and service-driven spirit of SLS The Red Sea.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle internal and external guest communications promptly and professionally, maintaining a warm and engaging SLS tone.
  • Serve as a central point of contact for guest inquiries, requests, and service needs throughout their stay.
  • Provide clear and accurate information about hotel facilities, dining, spa, activities, promotions, services, and local attractions.
  • Coordinate guest requests with relevant departments, including Housekeeping, Engineering, Room Service, Front Office, and other operational teams.
  • Log, track, and follow up on guest requests to ensure timely completion and a seamless guest experience.
  • Handle guest feedback and concerns professionally, taking appropriate action and escalating matters when required.
  • Manage wake-up call requests accurately and follow established procedures for unanswered calls.
  • Transfer calls and communications accurately to the appropriate departments, guest rooms, or colleagues when required.
  • Support Front Office operations during night hours, including assisting with room availability and booking inquiries when required.
  • Respond calmly and efficiently to emergency communications and follow established hotel emergency procedures.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and security when handling guest information and sensitive operational matters.
  • Accurately record guest messages, requests, service notes, and relevant information in Opera PMS and other designated hotel systems.
  • Review and maintain accurate guest information in hotel systems in accordance with established procedures.
  • Monitor communication systems and promptly report any technical issues to the Supervisor or Engineering team.
  • Maintain accurate daily logs and operational reports relating to guest requests, communications, and service performance.
  • Stay updated on daily arrivals, in-house VIPs, special occasions, events, hotel activities, and relevant operational information.
  • Promote appropriate hotel services and experiences based on guest needs and preferences.
  • Maintain a professional and organized Guest Service Centre environment and ensure all equipment is ready for operation.
  • Follow departmental SOPs, service standards, training guidelines, handovers, and communication procedures.
  • Support the onboarding and cross-training of new colleagues when required.
  • Participate in departmental briefings, meetings, training, and continuous development activities.
  • Support additional Guest Service Centre, Front Office, and administrative duties as required by the Supervisor or Management team.

qualifications.text:
• High School Diploma or higher; a qualification in Hospitality, Guest Services, or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Guest Services, Front Office, Call Centre, PBX, or a similar guest-facing role, preferably within a luxury or lifestyle hotel.
  • Excellent command of spoken and written English is essential, with a clear, confident, and professional telephone manner.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Opera PMS; experience with hotel communication or guest request management systems is an advantage.
  • Strong guest service, communication, and interpersonal skills with a warm and professional approach.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and respond efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent attention to detail with a strong commitment to guest privacy and confidentiality.
  • Strong coordination and follow-up skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across hotel departments.
  • Proactive, flexible, and composed under pressure, with a genuine passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Reservations Manager leads the Reservations department for FAENA The Red Sea, setting the standard of warmth, artistry, and precision that defines every guest’s first impression of the FAENA Culture. The role is responsible for the strategic and operational management of the reservations function, driving revenue performance and ensuring every booking journey reflects the sophistication, exclusivity, and emotive storytelling of the FAENA brand. The Reservations Manager partners closely with Revenue Management, Front Office, Sales & Marketing, and Guest Experience teams to translate FAENA’s vision of curated indulgence into flawless, personalised booking experiences from first inquiry to arrival.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Champion and reinforce a culture of warmth, precision, and pride within the reservations function, consistent with the FAENA Culture.
  • Oversee day-to-day reservations operations across all channels (phone, email, OTAs, GDS, direct website) ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and an exceptional guest experience at every touchpoint.
  • Set, monitor, and enforce reservations standards, scripts, and service protocols aligned with FAENA’s luxury positioning and brand voice.
  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Management to implement pricing strategy, rate integrity, availability controls, and inventory allocation across all distribution channels.
  • Analyse booking pace, pickup, denials, and cancellation trends; recommend action plans to maximise occupancy and RevPAR.
  • Review and approve complex, VIP, and high-value reservations, ensuring bespoke arrangements are curated and flawlessly executed.
  • Champion upselling and cross-selling of room categories, experiences, and packages to elevate guest journeys and drive ancillary revenue.
  • Ensure the Property Management System (PMS) and all channel managers reflect accurate rates, availability, and content at all times.
  • Collaborate with Front Office, Housekeeping, and Guest Experience teams to guarantee seamless arrivals, departures, and fulfilment of special requests.
  • Handle guest escalations and booking-related service recovery with discretion, empathy, and a solutions-first approach.
  • Conduct regular audits of reservation records for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with brand standards and data privacy regulations.
  • Prepare and present reservations performance reports, forecasts, and departmental budgets to senior leadership.
  • Recruit, train, and evaluate reservations team members; conduct performance reviews and identify development opportunities.
  • Maintain deep knowledge of resort offerings, experiences, promotions, and the destination to inspire and inform the guest journey.
  • Manage overbooking strategy and inventory control in coordination with Revenue Management, minimising risk while optimising occupancy.
  • Stay current on luxury hospitality trends, competitor positioning, and guest expectations, bringing insights back to elevate the FAENA offering.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
QUALIFICATIONS DESIRED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 4–6 years of progressive experience in reservations or revenue-related roles within luxury hospitality, including at least 1–2 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity.
  • Proven experience with Property Management Systems (PMS), Central Reservation Systems (CRS), GDS, and channel management platforms.
  • Strong understanding of hotel/resort operations, rate structures, revenue management principles, and distribution strategy.
  • Pre-opening experience within a luxury resort or lifestyle brand is an advantage.
  • Fluency in English required; additional languages are a strong advantage.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
SKILLS

  • Inspirational leadership with the ability to coach, motivate, and hold a team accountable to luxury service standards.
  • Strong commercial acumen with an analytical, revenue-driven mindset.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills across all levels of the organisation.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy in data and financial handling.
  • Composed, solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving under pressure.
  • Strong organisational and time-management abilities, able to balance strategic and operational priorities.
  • Collaborative team player who partners effectively across Front Office, Revenue, Sales, and Marketing.
  • Proficiency in reservations technology, Microsoft Office, and reporting tools.
  • A refined, guest-centric sensibility that embodies the artistry, warmth, and sophistication of the FAENA Culture.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling VIP, celebrity, or high-profile guest arrangements.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Sous Chef plays a pivotal leadership role within the Culinary team at Faena The Sea.

This position works closely with the Chef de Cuisine to ensure the flawless execution of Faena’s culinary vision, maintaining the highest standards of food quality, presentation, and Forbes Five-Star service. The Sous Chef leads by example, demonstrating hands-on mastery of kitchen operations while mentoring and developing the culinary brigade to embody Faena’s artistry, discipline, and creativity.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Excellence

· Supervises and coordinate daily kitchen operations, ensuring consistency, quality, and timely service.

· Oversees assigned kitchen stations and production areas, maintaining adherence to recipes, presentation standards, and portion control.

· Conducts daily line checks to ensure readiness, organization, and product quality.

· Supports menu development, seasonal updates, and special event menus in collaboration with senior culinary leadership.

· Maintains compliance with all health, safety, and sanitation regulations.

· Ensures all kitchen equipment and facilities are maintained in optimal condition.

Leadership & Team Development

· Leads and motivate culinary staff to deliver exceptional results while fostering a positive, collaborative work culture.

· Trains, mentors, and evaluates team members, ensuring continuous development and alignment with Faena’s brand values.

· Supervises cooks of all levels (Cook 1–4) and ensure that standards of preparation, plating, and timing are met.

· Conducts pre-service briefings and communicate effectively with both front- and back-of-house teams to ensure seamless service.

· Leads by example through professionalism, efficiency, and creativity.

Financial & Administrative Responsibilities

· Assists the Executive Sous Chef in controlling food and labor costs through effective scheduling, waste management, and purchasing controls.

· Maintains inventory accuracy and monitor stock levels for daily operations.

· Reviews sales and cost reports to identify opportunities for improvement and efficiency.

· Supports vendor relationships and ensure sourcing of premium ingredients consistent with Faena’s luxury standards.

Guest Experience & Brand Representation

· Ensures all culinary creations reflect Faena’s artistic and storytelling-driven identity.

· Partners with the Events, Banquet, and Restaurant teams to deliver flawless guest experiences for VIP functions and luxury events.

· Upholds Forbes Five-Star and AAA Five-Diamond standards in all culinary and service interactions.

· Represents Faena’s culinary excellence in tastings, inspections, and special occasions.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
QUALIFICATIONS

· Minimum 5 years of progressive culinary experience, with at least 2 years in a leadership role in a luxury hotel, resort, or fine-dining restaurant.

· Formal culinary education or equivalent apprenticeship required.

· Proven experience managing high-volume, multi-outlet kitchen operations.

· Strong organizational, leadership, and communication skills.

· Comprehensive knowledge of food safety, HACCP, and sanitation standards.

· Financial acumen related to food cost control and labor management.

· ServSafe or equivalent certification required.

· Flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Personal Attributes

· Hands-on leader who thrives in a creative and disciplined culinary environment.

· Passionate about hospitality, artistry, and excellence in guest experience.

· Calm, composed, and solution-oriented under pressure.

· Embodies Faena’s core values of authenticity, teamwork, and innovation.

jobDescription.text:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Assistant Director of Sales at Faena The Red Sea supports the Director of Sales in driving the hotel’s overall sales strategy and revenue performance across all key market segments, including luxury leisure, corporate, government and royal affairs, diplomatic, groups, MICE, entertainment, wholesale, consortia, and strategic partnerships across KSA, GCC, and international source markets.

This role is responsible for leading day-to-day sales activities, developing and managing high-value accounts, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring a disciplined approach to account management, prospecting, conversion, and market penetration. The Assistant Director of Sales will work across segments to maximize rooms, suites, villas, group, event, dining, wellness, and exclusive buyout opportunities while supporting the positioning of Faena The Red Sea as one of the region’s leading ultra-luxury destinations.

As a key member of the Commercial leadership team, the Assistant Director of Sales will support the Director of Sales in leading the Sales team, coordinating cross-segment strategies, monitoring performance against targets, and ensuring strong collaboration with Revenue Management, Marketing, Events, Reservations, Operations, and other hotel departments. The role will also act as a senior commercial ambassador for Faena The Red Sea in key domestic and international markets.

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

· Support the DOS in developing and executing the hotel’s annual sales strategy, business plan, and segment action plans across all key markets.

· Drive business development across luxury leisure, corporate, government and royal affairs, diplomatic, groups, MICE, wholesale, consortia, entertainment, and other strategic segments.

· Manage and grow a portfolio of high-value accounts while actively prospecting for new business opportunities across KSA, GCC, and key international feeder markets.

· Support the Sales team in achieving individual and departmental revenue targets, account production goals, conversion objectives, and market share growth.

· Develop strong relationships with luxury travel advisors, tour operators, DMCs, consortia partners, corporate decision-makers, government entities, embassies, family offices, event planners, and other key intermediaries.

· Identify and convert opportunities for suites and villas, luxury leisure stays, corporate travel, groups, executive retreats, incentive programs, private events, celebrations, and exclusive buyouts.

· Lead and support negotiations for corporate agreements, preferred partnerships, group contracts, wholesale agreements, consortia opportunities, and other commercially beneficial arrangements.

· Conduct sales calls, presentations, site inspections, familiarization trips, client entertainment, and relationship-building activities to showcase Faena The Red Sea and the wider Red Sea destination.

· Represent Faena The Red Sea at key trade shows, roadshows, sales missions, networking events, client events, and industry forums in domestic and international markets.

· Work closely with Revenue Management to align sales activity with pricing strategy, need periods, market demand, displacement considerations, and revenue optimization objectives.

· Partner with Marketing and Communications on tactical campaigns, trade marketing initiatives, partner activations, sales collateral, and market-specific demand generation opportunities.

· Collaborate closely with Events, Reservations, and Operations to ensure accurate handover and seamless execution of group, VIP, corporate, leisure, and high-profile business.

· Maintain accurate account plans, sales activities, pipelines, opportunities, production data, call reports, and client information within the hotel CRM and commercial systems.

· Monitor competitor activity, market trends, feeder market performance, new openings, airline connectivity, major events, and other intelligence that may influence demand and sales strategy.

· Prepare regular sales reports, forecasts, account reviews, and performance updates for the EAM – Commercial, highlighting opportunities, risks, and recommended actions.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:

· Minimum 7+ years of progressive luxury hospitality sales experience, with exposure to multiple segments such as luxury leisure, corporate, government, groups, MICE, wholesale, or consortia.

· Previous experience in an Assistant Director of Sales, Senior Sales Manager, Account Director, or comparable leadership role within a luxury or ultra-luxury hotel environment strongly preferred.

· Strong network and market knowledge across KSA and GCC, combined with an understanding of key international luxury feeder markets.

· Strong understanding of Saudi business culture, protocol etiquette, and relationship-led commercial development.

· Proven track record in securing high-value accounts and complex VIP business.

· Exceptional communication, presence, and stakeholder management skills.

· Ability to operate with absolute discretion and professionalism.

· Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen and negotiation ability.

· Fluency in English and Arabic is mandatory.

· Proficient in Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and hotel commercial platforms.

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Hospitality, International Relations, or related field preferred

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information

SKILLS

· Results-driven with a strong focus on revenue generation, conversion, account growth, and market share.

· Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.

· Strong analytical, forecasting, planning, and commercial decision-making capabilities.

· Entrepreneurial mindset with deep luxury hospitality and multi-segment sales knowledge.

The role includes assisting with meet-and-greet services, coordinating transportation, supporting luggage handling, and facilitating smooth transfers between the airport and the resort while delivering attentive, professional, and personalized guest service in line with ultra-luxury hospitality standards. 

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Welcome guests at the airport with a warm, professional, and personalized greeting.  

  • Assist guests during arrival and departure procedures to ensure a smooth airport experience.  

  • Identify and escort VIP guests, ensuring priority handling and special attention.  

  • Coordinate guest transfers between the airport and the resort, including transportation arrangements.  

  • Assist with luggage handling and ensure safe transfer of guest belongings to vehicles or resort representatives.  

  • Liaise with airport authorities, immigration staff, and transportation providers when necessary to facilitate guest movement.  

  • Monitor flight arrivals and departures to ensure timely coordination of guest services.  

  • Communicate guest arrivals, delays, or special requirements to the resort team.  

  • Provide guests with accurate information about resort transfers, timing, and services.  

  • Handle guest inquiries, concerns, or last-minute changes with professionalism and efficiency.  

  • Ensure all meet-and-greet signage, materials, and welcome setups are properly prepared.  

  • Maintain a polished and professional appearance in line with luxury hospitality standards.  

  • Support VIP protocols and ensure discreet, personalized service for high-profile guests.  

  • Coordinate closely with Concierge, Transportation, and Front Office teams.  

  • Ensure guest privacy, confidentiality, and security at all times.  

  • Maintain a calm and organized presence in busy airport environments.  

  • Report any operational issues, delays, or incidents promptly to management.  

  • Deliver a seamless transition from airport arrival to resort experience reflecting FAENA The Red Sea’s luxury standards.

companyDescription.text: Raffles & Fairmont The Red Sea, positioned in the Kingdom’s groundbreaking Red Sea Project, will provide visitors access to a nature-focused resort. With 361 rooms, eleven distinct dining concepts, including overwater restaurants with views of the Red Sea and the mangroves, and a spa. It will set new standards in sustainable development, positioned on 200km of untouched coastline, an archipelago of more than 90 unspoiled islands, dormant volcanoes, rich marine habitat, and ancient archaeological sites.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
As a Commis Chef at Fairmont The Red Sea, you will support the kitchen team in delivering exceptional, 5-star culinary experiences. You will assist with mise en place, preparation, and service while maintaining the highest standards of quality, hygiene, and consistency.

Job Description

  • Maintain daily mise en place and prepare ingredients according to recipes and standards.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and presentation in all dishes prepared.
  • Follow recipes, portion control, and stock management procedures.
  • Assist during service and adjust preparation based on guest preferences when required.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and sanitary kitchen environment at all times.
  • Inspect and clean food preparation areas to ensure safe food-handling practices.
  • Keep up to date with new products, recipes, and preparation techniques.
  • Have a good understanding of all menu items, daily highlights, and promotions.
  • Support the team during busy operations and contribute to smooth kitchen service.
  • Follow all health, safety, and hygiene standards in line with hotel policies.
  • Attend kitchen briefings and report any issues to your supervisor.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Minimum 2 years in basic culinary position
  • Knowledge of different culinary techniques
  • Certificate in Culinary, preferred

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
• Understanding of ultra-luxury guest expectations and brand alignment.
  • Experience in Pre- Opening is a plus.
  • Regional Experience is a must.
  • Impeccable grooming and personal presentation aligned with luxury standards.

name: Chef De Partie - Raffles The Red Sea

companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: Raffles & Fairmont The Red Sea, positioned in the Kingdom’s groundbreaking Red Sea Project, will provide visitors access to a nature-focused resort. jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Chef de Partie is responsible for managing a specific kitchen section and ensuring the highest standards of food quality, presentation, and consistency in line with Raffles & Fairmont brand standards. The role supports the Sous Chef and Chef de Cuisine in daily operations while leading and developing junior chefs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take full responsibility for a designated kitchen section during preparation and service
  • Prepare, cook, and present dishes according to established recipes and luxury presentation standards
  • Supervise, train, and motivate Commis and Demi Chef de Partie team members
  • Ensure food quality, taste, and consistency meet Raffles & Fairmont expectations
  • Maintain strict adherence to HACCP, food safety, and hygiene standards
  • Control food costs by minimizing waste and ensuring proper stock handling (FIFO)
  • Assist in menu planning, recipe development, and new dish trials when required
  • Coordinate with other kitchen sections to ensure smooth service operations
  • Ensure cleanliness, organization, and proper maintenance of kitchen equipment
  • Follow hotel policies, grooming standards, and health & safety regulations

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Minimum 3–5 years of professional kitchen experience, including at least 1–2 years as Chef de Partie or equivalent
  • Experience in a luxury hotel or high-end restaurant is highly preferred
  • Culinary diploma or professional kitchen certification required
  • Strong knowledge of international cuisine (specialty cuisine is an advantage)
  • Proven understanding of HACCP and food safety standards
  • Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
• Understanding of ultra-luxury guest expectations and brand alignment.

  • Experience in project coordination, scheduling, and document control during pre-opening stages.

  • Experience in Pre- Opening is a plus.

  • Regional Experience is a must.

  • A proactive, anticipatory approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

  • Impeccable grooming and personal presentation aligned with luxury standards.

companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
“A passion for perfection”

Swissôtel Hotels & Resorts is a distinctive group of deluxe hotels where we put the emphasis on our people. We strive to provide a motivating and rewarding environment that attracts inspired and talented people who are willing to bring news ideas, use and develop their knowledge to reinvent their career path.

Swissôtel Al Maqam is Swissôtel’s Second hotel to open in Saudi Arabia. The hotel offers 1624 elegant rooms and suites with modern design, complementing the values of today’s Arab culture.

As part of the prestigious Abraj Al Bait complex, the deluxe Swissôtel Al Maqam is a contemporary five-star hotel located in close proximity to the holy Masjid Al Haraam, overlooking the Ka’aba and the Grand Mosque.

Swissôtel Al Maqam is part of a new urban development, including two restaurants, one executive lounge, two meeting rooms and a business centre. It has private entrances that make it easier for our valuable gusts to reach Al Masjid Al Haram

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Summary of Responsibilities:
Reporting to the security manager responsibilities and essential job functions include but are not limited to the following:

  • Responsible for all Guests and colleagues within their line of sight, which includes the car park
  • Patrol their designated area only
  • Be alert for fire hazards and unsafe work practices and unsafe conditions.
  • Be able to act according to all Emergency Response Plans
  • Maintain good public relations with Guests
  • Report for duty at least 15 minutes prior to shift starting time
  • Be present at all daily briefings and de-briefings
  • Know the position and name of every Security Officer on shift
  • Maintain follow up action to ensure adherence to schedules and work standards
  • Be alert for any unusual occurrences and take appropriate action  
  • Primarily responsible for safeguarding property, employees and patrons of the hotel
  • Make detailed reports of all occurrences/incidents during your tour of duty. Fill in all incident/accident/end of shift reports without fail after every shift
  • Attend to all other relevant paperwork as needed
  • When reporting for or finishing duty, Security Officers will notify the Director or Assistant Director of Security
  • When assigned for a particular job or function, Security Officers will be guided by job descriptions
  • Security Officers will not discuss/ divulge department details/ information to any other colleagues/outsider/ media failing which defaulter’s services will be subject to Progressive Corrective Action up to and including dismissal.
  • Security Officers will be required to use common sense and make judicious decisions. The basic aim being to diffuse the situation as quickly as possible. They will be polite, diplomatic and professional in handling situations, yet firm in upholding the Fairmont’s policies and procedures

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Guest Service Excellence

  • Provide courteous, professional, and efficient food and beverage service at all times.
  • Anticipate guest needs, preferences, and expectations to exceed satisfaction.
  • Present menus proactively and provide detailed explanations of dishes and beverages.
  • Maintain strong product knowledge, including menu items, daily specials, and beverage offerings.
  • Handle guest feedback professionally and report any concerns to the Manager on Duty.

Operations

  • Serve and clear food and beverage items in a timely and unobtrusive manner.
  • Ensure tables are properly set, cleared, and reset according to service standards.
  • Support team members with food running, table service, and station refills.
  • Act as a link between Front of House and Back of House to ensure smooth service flow.
  • Follow opening and closing checklists to ensure seamless operations.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of service stations at all times.

Financial & Quality Standards

  • Support daily financial targets and operational goals of the outlet.
  • Follow all financial handling procedures as per company guidelines.
  • Maintain compliance with LQA, Forbes, and guest satisfaction benchmarks.

Health, Safety & Hygiene

  • Ensure full compliance with HACCP and FIFO standards.
  • Follow all health, safety, and emergency procedures, including evacuation protocols.
  • Report hazards and maintenance issues through the appropriate systems.

Teamwork & Communication

  • Maintain effective communication with colleagues and management.
  • Attend all briefings, meetings, and training sessions as required.
  • Support other departments when needed and contribute to overall hotel operations.
  • Uphold grooming and presentation standards at all times.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform any additional duties or special projects assigned by management.
  • Demonstrate accountability and ownership within the workplace.
  • Contribute to sustainability initiatives and responsible operational practices.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Nationality

  • This position is open to Saudi Nationals only.

Experience & Education

  • Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in a similar role, preferably within a luxury hospitality environment.
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong communication skills in English; additional languages are an advantage.
  • Excellent interpersonal and guest engagement skills.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to service excellence.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a diverse team.
  • Good time management and multitasking abilities.
  • Well-groomed, professional appearance and positive attitude.

Additional Requirements

  • Flexibility to work various shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
  • Knowledge of food safety, hygiene, and service standards.
  • Experience working with LQA, Forbes standards, or similar luxury benchmarks is an advantage.

name: Bell/Luggage Attendant - Raffles The Red Sea

companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
Raffles & Fairmont the Red Sea, positioned in the kingdom's groundbreaking Red Sea Project, will provide visitors access to two nature-focused resorts. With 361 rooms, 11 distinct dining concepts, including overwater restaurant with views of the Red Sea and the mangroves, and a Spa.

Raffles The Red Sea will be a sanctuary of refined elegance and timeless luxury, nestled within Saudi Arabia’s extraordinary Red Sea destination. Blending Raffles’ legendary graciousness and personalized service with the natural beauty and sustainability ethos of Red Sea Global, the property offers a curated haven for the world’s most discerning travelers.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Key Responsibilities

  • Arrival & Departure Excellence: Warmly greet guests at the entrance within seconds of arrival, using their names and titles whenever possible. Assist with opening car doors and safely unloading or loading luggage.
  • Luggage Management: Ensure the "safe keeping" of all incoming, outgoing, and stored baggage. This includes accurate tagging, organizing the luggage room into Arrival, Departure, and Long-Term sections, and maintaining a clear logbook.
  • Rooming & Orientation: Escort guests to their rooms and provide a professional orientation, explaining room features such as light switches, Wi-Fi, and amenities in an engaging way.
  • Property Ambassadorship: Maintain a constant presence in the lobby to offer assistance. Act as a "storyteller" by sharing knowledge about the hotel's heritage, local attractions, and facilities.
  • Operational Support: Coordinate with the Front Desk, Concierge, and Valet teams to ensure seamless guest transitions. Deliver messages, newspapers, and parcels promptly to guest rooms.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Performance Standards & Requirements

  • Grooming: Uphold impeccable grooming and personal presentation standards aligned with ultra-luxury expectations.
  • Physical Demands: Ability to stand for long periods and frequently lift or push/pull up to 50 lbs.
  • Service Excellence: Adhere to Raffles' Local Standard Operating Procedures (LSOP) and Leading Quality Assurance (LQA) standards.
  • Discretion: Maintain strict confidentiality regarding guest movements and information.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience: Typically at least 1–2 years in a luxury 5-star hospitality environment.
  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent is required; a degree in Hospitality Management is often an asset.
  • Skills: Excellent communication skills in English; additional languages (for example Arabic) are highly desirable.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
• Understanding of Ultra-Luxury guest expectations and brand alignment.
  • experience in project coordination, scheduling, and document control during pre-Opening stages.
  • Experience in pre-Opening is a must.
  • A proactive, anticipatory approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Impeccable grooming and personal presentation aligned with Luxury standards.

companyDescription.text:

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience & Service Excellence:

  • Provide warm, anticipatory, and personalized service to all guests in accordance with Raffles legendary service philosophy.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to guests by offering expert recommendations for dining, entertainment, cultural experiences, transportation, and exclusive local attractions.

  • Handle all guest requests efficiently, creatively, and discreetly, ensuring prompt follow-up and flawless execution.

  • Maintain detailed knowledge of guest preferences, special occasions, and cultural sensitivities to personalize every interaction.

Coordination & Operations:

  • Liaise closely with internal departments (Front Office, Housekeeping, Butler Service, F&B, Spa, Security) to ensure seamless guest experiences.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with external partners, luxury vendors, and service providers to secure preferred access and exclusive experiences for guests.

  • Manage reservations, ticketing, transportation arrangements, and special requests with precision and attention to detail.

  • Maintain accurate records of guest interactions and preferences in the property management system.

Standards, Etiquette & Brand Representation:

  • Uphold Raffles grooming, etiquette, and presentation standards at all times.

  • Demonstrate impeccable manners, refined communication skills, and cultural awareness befitting a luxury heritage brand.

  • Resolve guest concerns proactively and diplomatically, ensuring satisfaction and loyalty.

  • Act as a brand ambassador, embodying the values, history, and elegance of Raffles Hotels & Resorts.

Compliance & Professional Conduct:

  • Ensure compliance with hotel policies, safety procedures, and confidentiality requirements.

  • Handle sensitive guest information with the utmost discretion and integrity.

  • Participate in ongoing training to enhance product knowledge, service skills, and brand standards.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Qualifications & Experience:

  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a luxury hotel concierge or guest relations role (5-star or ultra-luxury preferred).

  • Les Clefs d’Or certification or eligibility is highly desirable.

  • Exceptional knowledge of the local destination, luxury lifestyle offerings, and high-end clientele expectations.

  • Proven ability to anticipate guest needs and deliver bespoke experiences.

Working closely with the Pastry Chef and Pastry Sous Chef, you will take responsibility for the daily operations of your assigned pastry section, ensuring that all products are prepared, presented, and executed to the highest standards of quality and consistency.

From daily mise en place and production to service and final presentation, your craftsmanship, attention to detail, and commitment to excellence will contribute to memorable dining experiences across SLS The Red Sea.

  • Take responsibility for the daily operations of the assigned pastry section, ensuring efficient preparation and smooth service.
  • Complete daily mise en place and ensure the section is fully prepared, organized, clean, and adequately stocked before and throughout service.
  • Monitor the quality, freshness, consistency, and presentation of all products prepared within the assigned section.
  • Follow recipes, portion control guidelines, preparation methods, and presentation standards accurately.
  • Support the Pastry Chef and Pastry Sous Chef in delivering daily production, special requests, events, and outlet requirements.

  • Monitor ingredient usage and communicate stock requirements, product shortages, or quality concerns to the Pastry Sous Chef.
  • Use pastry equipment safely and responsibly, reporting any faults, damage, or maintenance requirements promptly.
  • Contribute to minimizing food waste through effective production planning, portion control, and efficient use of ingredients.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient workstation throughout preparation, service, and closing operations.
  • Participate in training and development opportunities to enhance pastry techniques, product knowledge, and culinary skills.
  • Work collaboratively with the wider culinary team to ensure consistent quality and seamless service across all relevant outlets.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, creativity, attention to detail, and a genuine passion for pastry while contributing to the high standards of SLS The Red Sea.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
FAENA The Red Sea is seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Director of Sales to lead the resort's global sales strategy and position one of the world's most anticipated luxury lifestyle destinations within the international luxury travel market. This leadership role is responsible for driving revenue growth through strategic sales planning, business development, and long-term client partnerships while strengthening the resort's presence across international luxury leisure, corporate, entertainment, and MICE markets.

Working collaboratively with Marketing, Revenue Management, Reservations, and Operations, the Director of Sales will develop innovative sales strategies, build long-term relationships with key stakeholders, and lead a high-performing sales team to maximise business across all market segments. This role requires a strategic leader with extensive luxury hospitality experience, strong commercial acumen, and a proven ability to deliver exceptional business results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the resort's sales strategy to maximise revenue, market share, and long-term business growth.
  • Lead and inspire the Sales team, fostering a high-performance culture focused on results, collaboration, and continuous development.
  • Drive business across all key market segments including Leisure, Corporate, Entertainment, MICE, Consortia, and Wholesale.
  • Identify new business opportunities and cultivate strategic partnerships with luxury travel advisors, agencies, corporate accounts, and industry partners.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, travel partners, and stakeholders to generate repeat and new business.
  • Collaborate closely with Revenue Management to optimise pricing strategies, market segmentation, forecasting, and sales performance.
  • Partner with Marketing & Communications to develop integrated sales campaigns, promotional initiatives, and brand activations that support commercial objectives.
  • Prepare and execute sales plans, budgets, forecasts, and business development strategies.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and maintain competitive positioning.
  • Lead contract negotiations and commercial agreements with key accounts and strategic partners.
  • Represent FAENA The Red Sea at international trade shows, luxury travel events, sales missions, and networking opportunities.
  • Monitor sales performance through KPIs, reporting, and business analytics, implementing action plans where required.
  • Collaborate with operational leaders to ensure a seamless transition from sales to guest experience and long-term client satisfaction.
  • Manage the departmental budget while ensuring efficient use of resources and return on investment.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, brand standards, and commercial governance.
  • Support pre-opening commercial activities, including market positioning, account acquisition, and business development initiatives.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Sales, Marketing, or a related field; Master's degree is advantageous.
  • Minimum 8–10 years of progressive sales leadership experience within luxury hospitality or lifestyle brands.
  • Proven success in driving revenue growth and leading high-performing sales teams.
  • Strong knowledge of luxury travel distribution, international sales, and key source markets.
  • Experience managing strategic accounts, contract negotiations, and business development initiatives.
  • Excellent commercial, financial, and analytical acumen.
  • Outstanding negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with hotel sales systems, CRM platforms, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong understanding of revenue management principles and the ability to collaborate effectively with Revenue teams.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are highly desirable.
  • Experience with luxury hotel pre-openings is highly advantageous.
  • Ability to build strong relationships across ownership, corporate offices, and key industry partners while representing the FAENA brand at the highest level.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At SLS The Red Sea, every detail contributes to creating exceptional guest experiences. As a Laundry & Kitchen Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of the resort’s kitchen and laundry equipment through effective maintenance, timely repairs, and proactive technical support.

Working as part of the Engineering team, you will support daily operations by maintaining critical equipment, identifying potential issues, and delivering reliable solutions that allow our Culinary, Laundry, and Operations teams to perform at the highest standards while ensuring safety, quality, and operational excellence.

 

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on all kitchen and laundry equipment to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation.
  • Inspect, troubleshoot, and repair commercial kitchen equipment including ovens, combi ovens, fryers, grills, steamers, dishwashers, refrigeration units, and extraction systems.
  • Maintain laundry equipment including washers, dryers, ironing machines, and other related operational systems.
  • Conduct regular equipment inspections to identify faults, leaks, abnormal performance, or potential failures before they impact operations.
  • Carry out maintenance and repairs on both electrical and gas-operated equipment in accordance with safety standards and manufacturer guidelines.
  • Monitor refrigeration systems, chillers, freezers, and cold storage equipment to ensure proper temperature control and performance.
  • Respond promptly to maintenance requests from Culinary, Laundry, and operational teams to minimize downtime and service interruptions.
  • Perform routine checks and maintain accurate records of equipment condition, maintenance activities, repairs, and spare parts usage.
  • Assist with the installation, testing, and commissioning of new kitchen and laundry equipment.
  • Coordinate with external contractors and suppliers during equipment servicing, repairs, and technical support activities.
  • Ensure all kitchen and laundry equipment complies with health, safety, hygiene, and operational standards.
  • Support HACCP requirements by maintaining equipment reliability and reporting any issues affecting food safety operations.
  • Maintain tools, spare parts, and workshop areas in an organized and safe condition.
  • Provide technical support and communicate effectively with Engineering, Culinary, Laundry, and Operations teams.
  • Follow all fire, health, safety, and environmental regulations while performing maintenance activities.
  • Maintain a professional approach and contribute to a positive engineering culture through teamwork, accountability, and proactive support.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Minimum of 2 years’ experience as a Kitchen, Laundry, or Engineering Technician within a hospitality or hotel environment.
  • Hands-on experience with commercial kitchen and laundry equipment, including gas and electrical systems.
  • Knowledge of preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and basic repairs of equipment.
  • Basic understanding of HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems related to kitchen and laundry operations.
  • Familiarity with major kitchen and laundry equipment brands and models.
  • Understanding of HACCP compliance, food safety, and hygiene standards.
  • Ability to perform basic welding and minor fabrication tasks is an advantage.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work effectively with operational teams.
  • Proficient in written and spoken English.
  • Flexible to work shifts, weekends, holidays, and on-call duties as required.

jobDescription.text:
Job Summary

The Accounts Receivable & Income Auditor is responsible for managing customer accounts, ensuring timely collection of outstanding receivables, and verifying the accuracy and completeness of daily revenue transactions. This role ensures that all income is properly recorded, reconciled, and reported in accordance with company policies, accounting standards, and internal controls.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Receivable

  • Maintain and monitor customer accounts to ensure timely collection of outstanding balances.
  • Prepare and issue invoices, account statements, and credit notes.
  • Follow up with customers regarding overdue payments and resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Reconcile customer accounts and investigate payment differences.
  • Record receipts and allocate payments accurately in the accounting system.
  • Prepare aging reports and recommend actions for overdue accounts.
  • Coordinate with the Sales, Front Office, and Finance departments to resolve account-related issues.
  • Ensure compliance with company credit policies and procedures.

Income Audit

  • Audit daily revenue generated from all operational departments.
  • Verify the accuracy of sales, cash, credit card, bank transfers, and other payment transactions.
  • Reconcile daily revenue reports with the Property Management System (PMS), Point of Sale (POS), and accounting system.
  • Review discounts, voids, refunds, complimentary transactions, and adjustments to ensure proper authorization.
  • Prepare daily revenue and income audit reports for management.
  • Investigate and report revenue discrepancies or irregularities.
  • Ensure all revenues are correctly posted to the appropriate accounts.
  • Support month-end closing and financial reporting activities.

qualifications.text:

As a Host/Hostess, you will play a key role in delivering exceptional guest experiences by warmly welcoming, guiding, and assisting guests throughout their dining journey. As the face of the restaurant, you will create a refined and personalized arrival experience that reflects the bold, stylish, and vibrant spirit of SLS.

Working closely with the F&B team, you will support smooth front-of-house operations by managing guest flow, reservations, seating arrangements, and ensuring every guest interaction reflects SLS standards, service excellence, and genuine hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome and engage guests in a warm, professional, and confident manner aligned with SLS service standards.

  • Coordinate with the service team to accommodate guest requests and ensure expectations are met.

companyDescription.text:
Raffles & Fairmont the Red Sea, positioned in the kingdom's groundbreaking Red Sea Project, will provide visitors access to two nature-focused resorts. With 361 rooms, 11 distinct dining concepts, including overwater restaurant with views of the Red Sea and the mangroves, and a Spa.

Raffles The Red Sea will be a sanctuary of refined elegance and timeless luxury, nestled within Saudi Arabia’s extraordinary Red Sea destination. jobDescription.title: Job Description

Operational Supervision & Quality Assurance:

  • Ensure the restaurant environment reflects the rich heritage and multicultural identity of Mediterranean cuisine, blending elegance with vibrant authenticity in ambiance, presentation, and service flow.
  • Conduct daily briefings and meticulous inspections to ensure consistency in food quality, service rituals, cleanliness, and attention to detail.
  • Maintain strict control of inventory, sourcing, and cost management, ensuring the use of authentic ingredients while optimizing efficiency and minimizing waste.
  • Ensure full compliance with HACCP standards, local regulations, and Raffles operational policies.

Guest Experience & Service Excellence:

  • Curate a soulful and immersive Mediterranean dining journey, where each guest experience is personalized, memorable, and emotionally engaging.
  • Bring dishes to life through storytelling, sharing the heritage, cultural influences, and inspirations behind each offering, reflecting the Mediterranean's diverse culinary identity.
  • Anticipate guest needs with intuition and grace, ensuring seamless service delivery that feels both effortless and bespoke.
  • Handle guest feedback and service recovery with empathy, discretion, and a commitment to turning moments into lasting impressions.
  • Build meaningful relationships with guests, recognizing preferences and creating a sense of belonging that encourages return visits.

Team Leadership & Development:

  • Lead and inspire a team of Heartists®, fostering a culture of passion, pride, and excellence in every interaction.
  • Coach and develop team members on service artistry, Mediterranean cuisine knowledge, and personalized guest engagement.
  • Embed Raffles service culture through continuous training, storytelling, and role modeling of brand values.
  • Ensure high standards of grooming, professionalism, and emotional intelligence within the team.
  • Support talent development, succession planning, and the growth of future leaders within the Raffles family.

Financial Performance & Commercial Focus:

  • Drive revenue growth through strategic upselling, promotions, and optimization of average check value.
  • Monitor financial performance, including revenue, labor costs, and cost of sales, ensuring alignment with budget targets.
  • Prepare forecasts, analyze trends, and implement action plans to improve profitability.
  • Collaborate with marketing and events teams to promote the Mediterranean restaurant through campaigns, activations, and partnerships.
  • Ensure accurate billing, cash handling, and compliance with financial procedures.

Brand, Culture & Pre-Opening Excellence:

  • Bring to life the spirit of Raffles through the restaurant concept, blending timeless elegance with the vibrant soul of Mediterranean cuisine.
  • Support pre-opening initiatives including recruitment, onboarding, training programs, and the creation of bespoke service rituals.
  • Contribute to the development of SOPs, guest journey mapping, and service choreography aligned with Raffles standards.
  • Champion a culture of belonging, creativity, and excellence, where every team member contributes to creating “magic".
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure a seamless and elevated guest journey across all touchpoints.

Health, Safety & Compliance:

  • Ensure adherence to all health, safety, and hygiene standards in line with local regulations and company policies.
  • Conduct regular audits and ensure corrective actions are implemented promptly.
  • Promote a safe working environment for colleagues and guests at all times.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Cluster Director of Engineering is responsible for providing strategic leadership, operational oversight, and technical governance for the Engineering & Safety functions across FRSS hotels by working closely with hotel leadership teams and stakeholders.

The role ensures the reliability, safety, efficiency, and long-term sustainability of all engineering operations, assets, infrastructure, and building systems while maintaining compliance with company standards, brand requirements, and regulatory obligations.

The Cluster Director of Engineering drives engineering performance, supports business objectives, and ensures that all properties maintain a safe, well-maintained, compliant, and guest-ready environment.

MAIN DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Cluster Engineering Leadership & Governance:

  • Provide a strategic leadership and oversight for the Engineering and Safety functions across FRSS hotels hotel, ensuring alignment with operational objectives, brand standards, and asset performance goals.
  • FRSS are physically linked and share core utilities, hence, enable integrated operations and maintain engineering governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and performance standards to ensure consistency across FRSS hotels.
  • Oversee the centralized shared functions such as Safety & Compliance, Central Store & Logistics, Workshops (Carpentry, Paint, MEP), PMP (Room Care Program) and Engineering command center.
  • Lead, mentor, the robust succession & development of Engineering leaders and teams across FRSS hotels by centralized coaching and mentoring builds bench strength, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Engineering Operations & Asset Reliability:

  • One clear escalation path to ownership and asset management, reducing duplication, oversee the effective operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of all building systems, utilities, infrastructure, and engineering assets across FRSS hotels.
  • Ensure the uniform application of Accor technical standards and MEP/FLS compliance at FRSS hotels.
  • Ensure the implementation of preventive and predictive maintenance programs that maximize asset reliability, operational efficiency, and guest satisfaction.
  • Monitor engineering performance metrics and operational KPIs, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce downtime, and enhance overall asset performance.
  • Sustainability & ESG: Suggested incorporating energy efficiency and carbon footprint reduction goals aligned with Accor standards.
  • Ensure specialized fire life safety, water hygiene, public health, and operational compliance regimes are implemented for Luxury Hotel - FRSS facilities in line with applicable KSA regulatory and public health requirements.
  • Coordinate maintenance, testing, inspection, and contractor support for engineering assets to maintain safe, reliable, and guest-ready operations.
  • Ensure to optimize resource deployment, technical manpower and specialist skills to where demands are highest across FRSS hotels.

Capital Planning & Project Management:

  • Lead the development and execution of annual CAPEX plans, engineering budgets, and long-term asset replacement strategies across FRSS.
  • Financial & CAPEX/OPEX Management: Suggested adding budget governance, energy cost optimization, and capital asset planning (essential for a Cluster Director role).
  • Oversee engineering projects, renovations, upgrades, and new initiatives, ensuring delivery within approved budgets, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to ensure successful project execution and compliance with company requirements.

SKILLS:

  • Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
  • Excellent strategic planning and decision-making skills.
  • Strong project management and execution skills.
  • Financial acumen with the ability to manage budgets, forecasts, and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities across a portfolio environment.
  • Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
  • Ability to drive innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  • High level of organizational, planning, and change management capability.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline is required; Master’s degree in Engineering Management, or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum 10-15 years of progressive engineering leadership experience within hospitality, and multi-property experience.
  • Proven experience managing engineering operations across multiple properties or large-scale assets.

jobDescription.text:
The Food & Beverage Server is responsible for providing exceptional and personalized dining experiences by delivering professional, efficient, and attentive table service in accordance with the hotel's standards. The role ensures guests receive prompt service, accurate order delivery, and a welcoming dining atmosphere while supporting the smooth operation of all Food & Beverage outlets.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Guest Service

  • Welcome guests warmly and escort them to their tables where applicable.

  • Maintain personal grooming and hygiene standards in accordance with hotel policies.

Cash Handling & Administration

  • Process guest bills accurately using the POS system.
  • Handle cash, credit card, and other payment methods according to hotel procedures.

  • Complete side duties, opening and closing checklists, and shift handovers.
  • Maintain accurate records of guest checks and transactions where required.

Collaboration

  • Pre-opening experience is an advantage.

The Steward is responsible for maintaining the cleanliness, sanitation, and organization of all kitchen, stewarding, and back-of-house food service areas. The role ensures that all kitchen equipment, utensils, crockery, cutlery, and operating equipment are cleaned, sanitized, and readily available to support smooth culinary and Food & Beverage operations. Stewarding Operations

  • Clean, wash, sanitize, and store kitchen equipment, utensils, crockery, cutlery, glassware, pots, pans, and kitchen tools.
