  • Ensure adequate supplies of clean operating equipment are available throughout service periods.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of stewarding, kitchen, and back-of-house areas.
  • Assist with the setup and breakdown of kitchen and banquet equipment as required.

Cleaning & Sanitation

  • Clean floors, walls, drains, workstations, storage areas, and waste disposal areas according to cleaning schedules.
  • Follow established cleaning and sanitation procedures to maintain food-safe environments.
  • Ensure all cleaning chemicals are used, stored, and labeled correctly.
  • Maintain cleanliness of waste bins and garbage collection areas.
  • Perform deep-cleaning tasks according to departmental schedules.

 

Food Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
  • Ensure proper segregation and disposal of food waste and recyclable materials.
  • Use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when handling chemicals or equipment.
  • Report hygiene concerns, equipment malfunctions, and safety hazards immediately.
  • Participate in food safety inspections and internal audits.

jobDescription.text:
The Sales Manager at Faena The Red Sea plays a key role in driving revenue growth and 
establishing the property’s presence within the global luxury travel market during the preopening and launch phase. This position is responsible for proactively generating transient,
corporate, and group business within assigned territories and market segments, while 
building strategic relationships that position Faena The Red Sea as one of the region’s most 
sought-after ultra-luxury destinations.
As a brand ambassador, the Sales Manager represents Faena’s distinctive blend of culture, 
lifestyle, wellness, and hospitality, ensuring the hotel is strongly positioned among luxury 
travel advisors, entertainment networks, corporate accounts, and high-value clientele.
This role works closely with Revenue Management, Reservations, and Operations to convert 
opportunities, maximize market share, and deliver a seamless guest journey from enquiry to 
arrival.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

  • Develop and execute targeted sales action plans for assigned territories, market segments, and accounts. 
  • Proactively solicit and generate new business opportunities across transient, leisure, corporate, entertainment, and group segments. 
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with luxury travel advisors, preferred agencies, corporate travel buyers, family offices, concierge networks, and lifestyle partners.
  • Represent Faena The Red Sea at international trade shows, roadshows, sales missions, networking events, and client activations. 
  • Conduct regular sales calls, presentations, and site inspections to secure new business and strengthen partnerships. 
  • Achieve or exceed individual monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals. 
  • Work closely with Revenue Management to understand market demand, pricing strategy, and pace reports to identify opportunities. 
  • Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns, promotions, and lead generation initiatives that drive awareness and conversion. 
  • Maintain accurate account plans, activity reports, pipelines, and opportunities in Delphi / Salesforce CRM systems. 
  • Negotiate corporate and consortia agreements in line with hotel commercial strategy. 
  • Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and changing travel patterns within assigned territories. 
  • Coordinate with Reservations and Operations teams to ensure smooth execution of client bookings, VIP arrivals, and group requirements. 
  • Support pre-opening commercial initiatives including database development, account mapping, collateral distribution, and launch campaigns. 
  • Foster strong working relationships with Accor Global Sales Offices and relevant Ennismore commercial teams to maximize account production.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
As the Electronics Technician at Movepick Waad al Shamal, you contribute to the reliability, functionality, and guest satisfaction by performing first-level electronic maintenance, testing, and repair activities on hotel systems and equipment. The role directly supports hotel operations and the processing of routine maintenance requests, according to established work methods, and remains available to assist operations as needed, including emergency response during peak occupancy periods.

Hotel Systems Maintenance and Installation

 

  • Install, maintain, and troubleshoot electronic components in guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house facilities according to specifications and procedures provided.
  • Properly use hand tools and precision instruments required for maintenance and repairs.
  • Ensure the visual and functional conformity of all installed and repaired systems.
  • Identify and report any anomalies, malfunctions, or safety concerns observed during maintenance activities.
  • Maintain an orderly, safe work environment that complies with hotel safety standards and regulations.

 

Functional Testing and System Verification

 

  • Perform diagnostic tests on hotel systems (HVAC controls, lighting systems, security equipment, guest room electronics) according to established procedures.
  • Use appropriate test equipment and diagnostic tools to identify system issues.
  • Document test results and maintenance activities in accordance with hotel records and compliance requirements.

 

Equipment Repair and Restoration

 

  • Diagnose electronic problems using established procedures and troubleshooting tools.
  • Perform repairs and replacement of defective components in hotel systems and guest room equipment.
  • Test repaired systems to confirm proper functioning and guest safety.
  • Document all interventions and maintenance performed according to hotel standards.
  • Escalate complex issues to senior technicians or external specialists when required.

 

Contribution to Operational Excellence and Guest Satisfaction

 

  • Apply all hotel procedures, maintenance protocols, and safety instructions in force.
  • Execute maintenance work according to operational priorities and guest service schedules.
  • Respond promptly to maintenance requests to minimize guest disruption.
  • Report recurring issues, system failures, or opportunities for equipment upgrades.
  • Support hotel operations during peak periods and emergency situations to ensure continuous service delivery.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• NVQ Level 3 or 4 (or equivalent) in Electronics, Mechatronics, or Electrical Engineering from a recognized institute.
  • Proven experience (minimum 2 years) as an Electronics Technician in a luxury hospitality environment or 5-star hotel setting.
  • Strong practical knowledge of hotel electronic systems, including HVAC controls, lighting systems, security equipment, and guest room technology.
  • Hands-on experience in troubleshooting, diagnosing, and repairing electronic components and systems.
  • Proficiency with diagnostic test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and specialized hotel system diagnostic tools.
  • Excellent critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills with the ability to work under pressure and respond to emergency situations.
  • Strong team player with the ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks efficiently, and prioritize guest satisfaction.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with a commitment to discretion and professionalism in a luxury hotel environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, email, and hotel maintenance management systems is preferred.
  • Knowledge of hotel safety standards, compliance regulations, and guest service protocols is highly desirable.
  • Certification in hospitality maintenance or hotel systems management is an added advantage.
  • Age between 22–40 years is desirable.

Mantis Collection

An exceptional place to find yourself

About Mantis

Mantis is a leading conservation-focused hotel brand with eco-lodges, waterways and curated eco-escapes located in remote destinations. Sustainable travellers have been enjoying eco-tourism, safaris and adventure travel with Mantis since 2000. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate.

Acclaimed for its pioneering work in development, management, marketing, education and conservation, Mantis’s business model successfully combines responsible tourism, conservation and adventure, which translates to one-of-a-kind travel experiences. Whether small and intimate or vast and complex, on a sweeping African plain, in a bustling city, or in the midst of a forest, each is an exceptional place for guests to find themselves.

While uniquely different in the experiences they offer, all are linked through a collective ambition to be extraordinary; to be rare in a world that mass-produces sameness. Mantis consistently curates, collects and discovers destinations and experiences that stir the soul, defy expectations and live in the heart forever. Mantis is part of Accor, a world leading hospitality group offering experiences across more than 110 countries, with 5,700 properties, 10,000 food & beverage venues, wellness facilities or flexible workspaces, and a participating brand in ALL - Accor Live Limitless – a lifestyle loyalty program providing access to a wide variety of rewards, services and experiences. For more information visit: www.mantiscollection.com

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
As Marketing & PR Manager at Basiqat Resort by Mantis, you will be responsible for developing and executing the resort’s marketing, communications, and public relations strategy, building awareness and positioning the property as a distinctive luxury destination.

Working closely with the resort leadership team and regional marketing functions, you will drive brand storytelling, media engagement, digital presence, partnerships, and guest acquisition initiatives that reflect the Mantis ethos of meaningful travel, conservation, and authentic experiences.

This role requires a creative, commercially minded marketer who understands luxury hospitality, is passionate about storytelling, and can build strong relationships across media, influencers, partners, and local communities.

What You'll Do

Marketing Strategy & Brand Positioning

  • Develop and execute the resort’s marketing and communications plan aligned with Mantis brand values and commercial objectives
  • Build awareness of Basiqat Resort as a unique luxury destination within Saudi Arabia and internationally
  • Translate the resort’s experiences, landscape, and guest offerings into compelling brand stories
  • Support pre-opening marketing activities, campaigns, and launch initiatives

Public Relations & Media Engagement

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with media, journalists, influencers, and industry partners
  • Drive PR initiatives, press releases, media visits, and storytelling opportunities
  • Coordinate media engagement activities, including familiarisation trips and resort experiences
  • Monitor brand reputation and ensure consistent messaging across all channels

Digital Marketing & Content Creation

  • Manage the resort’s digital presence across social media, website, and relevant platforms
  • Develop engaging content strategies that showcase the resort experience, destination, and guest journey
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external agencies on content creation, photography, video, and campaigns
  • Monitor digital performance and identify opportunities to increase engagement and reach

Campaigns, Partnerships & Activations

  • Plan and execute marketing campaigns to support brand awareness, bookings, and revenue generation
  • Identify opportunities for strategic partnerships, collaborations, and local activations
  • Work closely with Sales, Revenue, F&B, and Operations teams to support commercial initiatives
  • Support events, launches, and bespoke guest experiences

Stakeholder & Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with the General Manager, Cluster Marketing, Sales, and regional teams to ensure alignment
  • Support the development of marketing materials, presentations, and brand communications
  • Manage relationships with agencies, suppliers, and creative partners
  • Ensure all communications reflect the luxury positioning and Mantis brand standards

Performance & Reporting

  • Track marketing activity, campaign performance, PR reach, and digital engagement metrics
  • Provide regular updates and insights to leadership teams
  • Identify opportunities to improve brand visibility, engagement, and commercial performance

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of marketing and communications experience, ideally within luxury hospitality, lifestyle, travel, or premium consumer brands
  • Strong understanding of PR, digital marketing, social media, and brand storytelling
  • Experience managing media relationships, partnerships, and influencer engagement
  • Proven ability to create compelling content and campaigns that drive awareness and engagement
  • Experience supporting luxury hotels, resorts, or destination marketing is highly desirable
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Creative mindset with strong commercial awareness

A creative and connected marketing professional who can bring the Basiqat story to life — combining luxury hospitality knowledge, strong PR instincts, and the ability to build meaningful brand connections in a new destination.

jobDescription.text:
Role Overview

As Front Office Manager at Basiqat Resort by Mantis, you will lead the front office operation, ensuring seamless guest journeys from arrival through departure. You will be responsible for creating warm, personalised and memorable experiences that reflect the Mantis philosophy, while maintaining the highest standards of service excellence.

This role requires a guest-focused leader who is passionate about luxury hospitality, thrives in a unique resort environment, and can inspire a team to deliver exceptional service while supporting operational readiness during the pre-opening phase.

What You'll Do

Front Office Operations Management

  • Oversee all daily Front Office operations including reception, guest services, concierge, and arrival/departure experiences
  • Ensure smooth and efficient guest journeys aligned with luxury hospitality standards
  • Maintain consistent service delivery across all guest touchpoints
  • Support pre-opening planning, systems setup, SOP development, and operational readiness

Guest Experience & Service Excellence

  • Create personalised and memorable guest experiences that reflect the Mantis brand ethos
  • Act as a visible ambassador of the resort, building strong guest relationships
  • Manage guest feedback, service recovery, and ensure timely resolution of concerns
  • Continuously identify opportunities to enhance the overall guest journey

Team Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, train, and develop a high-performing Front Office team
  • Lead daily briefings, coaching sessions, and performance discussions
  • Build a culture of ownership, teamwork, and genuine hospitality
  • Support team engagement, succession planning, and talent development

Operational & Commercial Performance

  • Monitor Front Office performance against key operational KPIs
  • Drive upselling opportunities, room revenue optimisation, and guest engagement initiatives
  • Work closely with Reservations, Sales, Revenue Management, and Finance teams
  • Support effective workforce planning, scheduling, and productivity management

Systems, Standards & Compliance

  • Ensure accurate use of PMS and Front Office systems
  • Maintain brand standards, policies, and operating procedures
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, Accor standards, and guest safety requirements
  • Support audit readiness and continuous improvement initiatives

Collaboration & Resort Experience

  • Partner closely with Housekeeping, F&B, Engineering, and Guest Experience teams to deliver a seamless resort operation
  • Support VIP arrivals, special occasions, and bespoke guest experiences
  • Contribute to creating a distinctive resort culture and sense of place

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and efficient Laundry Attendant to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will play a vital part in maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and organization within our laundry operations. Reporting to the Laundry Supervisor, you will be responsible for sorting, processing, and preparing linens while ensuring all health and safety protocols are consistently followed. Your commitment to quality and collaborative approach will directly contribute to the success of our housekeeping operations.

  • Sort soiled guestroom and food & beverage linens as required, filling containers and preparing them for pick-up with accurate labeling
  • Identify and set aside misused or damaged linen for further investigation and reporting
  • Report any foreign articles found within the linen or chute area (such as glass, food, cutlery, or needles) to the Supervisor immediately
  • Fold, roll, and organize clean towels, bathrobes, and room linens into containers for distribution by floor staff
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment at all times
  • Adhere to all health and safety protocols, including proper use of personal protective equipment such as masks and gloves
  • Assist with washing towels and linens when required, following all guidelines for chemical handling and proper lifting techniques
  • Report any equipment malfunctions or potential health and safety hazards to the Supervisor promptly
  • Support other team members and assist with additional duties within the laundry area as needed
  • Attend training courses and professional development sessions provided by the Housekeeping and Human Resources departments

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• High School diploma or vocational training certification
  • Minimum 1 year of work experience in laundry operations or housekeeping (preferred)
  • Basic understanding of the English language, both written and verbal
  • Physical capability to lift, carry, and handle items weighing up to 25 lbs regularly
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to follow instructions and procedures consistently and accurately
  • Knowledge of health and safety protocols and chemical handling best practices
  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills with a collaborative mindset
  • Reliability, punctuality, and strong work ethic
  • Physical stamina and endurance for a fast-paced laundry environment
  • Previous experience in luxury hotel housekeeping operations (preferred)
  • Problem-solving ability and resilience in a dynamic work setting

About the role:

We are looking for a passionate and experienced revenue manager ready to take their career to the next level: drive revenue growth across our iconic hotels and brands, optimize pricing strategies and channel performance, build best practices and work with sector-leading technology.

As Revenue Manager, you will collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing and Reservations teams, to optimize our revenue performance and achieve our business goals.

You will formulate and execute revenue strategies, manage inventory, and collaborate with the executive team on forecast and pricing. You will be a contributor to our revenue management community of practice internally and externally, mentor junior team members and receive learning and development support as you grow your career as a Heartist®.

Key Responsibilities:

 Develop and implement revenue strategies for the hotel.

 

  • Develop and implement revenue strategies for the hotel.
  • Monitor competitor pricing and market trends to adjust strategies.
  • Lead the weekly/bi-weekly Revenue Management meetings providing insights based on reporting data.
  • Develop topline revenue forecasts and actively seek opportunities to drive incremental profit across all revenue centers of the business.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews and optimize pricing and inventory.
  • Mentor, coach and develop junior team members in revenue management practices.
  • Collaborate with sales, finance, and front office teams to achieve revenue goals.
  • Ensure reservations are well managed and coordinate with the reservations team.
  • Drive market share in your competitive set and ensure all systems are adequately used to optimize RevPAR.
  • Leverage your knowledge of the distribution landscape, including online travel agencies and distribution networks to optimize hotel profits.
  • Responsible for data quality and system hygiene of Revenue Management and Distribution applications; platforms and tools used by the hotel.

qualifications.text:

  • Strong understanding of the distribution landscape, online travel agencies, and emerging market trends.
  • A collaborative forward-thinking mindset with a passion for elevating revenue management as a respected and valued community of practice with key internal and external stakeholders.

jobDescription.text:
he A/C Technician is responsible for the installation, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of heating, ventilation, air conditioning (HVAC), refrigeration, and ventilation systems throughout the hotel. The role ensures that all guest rooms, public areas, restaurants, banquet facilities, back-of-house areas, and critical mechanical systems operate efficiently and reliably, maintaining the highest standards of guest comfort, safety, energy efficiency, and luxury hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

Preventive Maintenance

  • Perform preventive maintenance on HVAC, refrigeration, ventilation, and chilled water systems according to the hotel's maintenance schedule.
  • Inspect, clean, lubricate, and adjust mechanical equipment to ensure optimal performance.
  • Replace filters, belts, bearings, motors, thermostats, valves, and other HVAC components as required.
  • Maintain accurate preventive maintenance records and equipment history.

Repairs and Troubleshooting

  • Diagnose and repair faults in air conditioning, refrigeration, ventilation, fan coil units (FCUs), air handling units (AHUs), package units, split systems, pumps, and associated controls.
  • Respond promptly to guest room and operational maintenance requests.
  • Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical faults using appropriate testing equipment.
  • Minimize equipment downtime through timely repairs and effective problem-solving.

Guest Room & Public Area Support

  • Ensure guest room air conditioning systems operate efficiently and quietly.
  • Maintain comfortable temperature and humidity levels throughout the hotel.
  • Respond immediately to guest complaints related to air conditioning or ventilation.
  • Coordinate maintenance activities to minimize disruption to guests and hotel operations.

Plant Room Operations

  • Monitor the performance of chillers, cooling towers, pumps, heat exchangers, and mechanical ventilation systems.
  • Record equipment operating parameters and report abnormalities.
  • Assist with plant shutdowns, startups, and seasonal maintenance activities.
  • Support emergency repairs to critical HVAC infrastructure.

Energy Management

  • Assist in implementing energy conservation initiatives.
  • Monitor HVAC performance to improve operational efficiency and reduce energy consumption.
  • Recommend equipment upgrades and maintenance improvements that enhance system reliability and sustainability.
  • Support the hotel's environmental and sustainability objectives.

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all occupational health and safety procedures during maintenance activities.
  • Ensure compliance with local building codes, environmental regulations, and refrigerant handling requirements.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times.
  • Report unsafe conditions and equipment defects immediately.
  • Maintain proper handling, recovery, storage, and disposal of refrigerants in accordance with applicable regulations.

Documentation

  • Complete work orders accurately and promptly through the hotel's maintenance management system.
  • Maintain maintenance logs, inspection records, and equipment documentation.
  • Report recurring equipment issues and recommend corrective actions.
  • Assist in maintaining spare parts inventory.

Teamwork

  • Coordinate with Engineering colleagues and other hotel departments during maintenance activities.
  • Support banquet, conference, and special event operations by ensuring HVAC systems are functioning properly.
  • Assist with general engineering duties when required.
  • Participate in emergency response procedures and technical standby coverage.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Qualifications

  • Diploma or technical certification in HVAC, Air Conditioning, Refrigeration, Mechanical Engineering, or a related trade.
  • Valid HVAC or refrigeration certification/license, where required by local regulations.
  • Minimum 3 years of HVAC maintenance experience, preferably in a luxury hotel, resort, hospital, or large commercial facility.
  • Experience working with Building Management Systems (BMS) is an advantage.

This role is responsible for maintaining, repairing, and servicing all commercial kitchen equipment to ensure the safe, efficient, and uninterrupted operation of the resort's culinary facilities. Working closely with the Engineering, Culinary, and Food & Beverage teams, the Kitchen Technician will play a key role in supporting operational excellence while ensuring compliance with health, safety, and food safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive maintenance on commercial kitchen equipment to minimise downtime.
  • Diagnose and repair faults on cooking, refrigeration, dishwashing, and food preparation equipment.
  • Maintain ovens, grills, fryers, steamers, combi ovens, refrigeration units, ice machines, and warewashing equipment.
  • Inspect and maintain kitchen exhaust systems, fans, and grease filtration equipment.
  • Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, gas, and refrigeration-related issues.
  • Assist with the installation, testing, and commissioning of new kitchen equipment.
  • Respond promptly to kitchen equipment breakdowns to minimise disruption to operations.
  • Coordinate with external contractors and equipment manufacturers for specialised repairs when required.
  • Monitor gas systems, safety devices, and kitchen equipment to ensure safe operation.
  • Ensure compliance with HACCP, health and safety, fire safety, and company engineering standards.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, work orders, and equipment history using the CMMS system.
  • Assist in managing spare parts inventory and maintenance supplies.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Sales Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth by developing and executing strategic sales plans across all market segments, including Corporate, Government, Leisure, Travel Trade, MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Exhibitions), and Social Events. The role focuses on maximizing hotel occupancy, meeting room utilization, food & beverage revenues, and long-term business partnerships while maintaining Mövenpick and Accor brand standards.

 

The Sales Manager will actively identify new business opportunities, maintain strong relationships with existing clients, and contribute to achieving the hotel's annual revenue targets.

 

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Business Development

Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve monthly and annual revenue targets.

Prospect and secure new business opportunities across all market segments.

Maintain and strengthen relationships with corporate accounts, government entities, travel agencies, and key decision-makers.

Conduct daily sales calls, client meetings, and outside sales activities.

Organize and participate in site inspections and hotel presentations.

Negotiate contracts, rates, and business agreements in line with hotel policies.

Promote guest rooms, meeting facilities, restaurants, catering services, and special promotions.

Account Management

Manage a portfolio of key accounts and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.

Conduct regular account reviews and identify opportunities for business growth.

Develop account plans for major clients.

Ensure timely follow-up on inquiries, proposals, and contracts.

Build long-term partnerships that generate repeat business.

Revenue Generation

Collaborate with the Revenue Management and Reservations teams to maximize yield and profitability.

Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and pricing strategies.

Prepare accurate sales forecasts and business reports.

Support the implementation of promotional campaigns and seasonal offers.

Events & Catering Sales Support

Work closely with the Food & Beverage and Events teams to generate banquet and catering business.

Promote weddings, conferences, social events, and outside catering opportunities.

Coordinate with operational departments to ensure successful event execution.

Customer Relationship Management

Maintain and update client information within the CRM system.

Ensure all sales activities are properly documented.

Respond promptly to client requests and resolve issues professionally.

Maintain excellent customer service standards and represent the hotel positively.

Administration & Reporting

Prepare weekly and monthly sales activity reports.

Monitor sales performance against targets and KPIs.

Participate in budget preparation and annual business planning.

Attend departmental meetings and contribute to strategic discussions.

Ensure compliance with Accor policies and procedures.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, or related field.

Minimum 3-5 years of experience in hotel sales, preferably in an international hotel brand.

Experience in Corporate, Government, and MICE sales is highly preferred.

Knowledge of the Saudi Arabian hospitality market is an advantage.

Valid driving license preferred.

Skills & Competencies

Technical Skills

Strong knowledge of hotel sales and marketing principles.

Understanding of revenue management strategies.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

Experience with CRM systems and hotel sales platforms.

Knowledge of Opera PMS, Delphi, Cvent, or similar hotel systems is an advantage.

Leadership Skills

Excellent negotiation and closing skills.

Strong communication and presentation abilities.

Ability to build and maintain business relationships.

Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and under pressure.

Team-oriented with strong organizational skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.

Number of new accounts acquired.

Corporate and government account production.

Meeting and banquet revenue generation.

Occupancy and average daily rate contribution.

Sales call productivity.

Client retention and repeat business.

Conversion ratio of inquiries to confirmed business.

Customer satisfaction scores.

Working Conditions

Full-time position.

Flexible working hours based on business requirements.

Frequent local travel for client meetings and sales visits.

Participation in trade shows, exhibitions, and networking events.

Core Values

 

The Sales Manager is expected to embody the values of Mövenpick Hotels & Resorts and Accor, demonstrating:

 

Guest Passion

Sustainable Performance

Spirit of Conquest

Trust

Innovation

Respect

Teamwork and Collaboration
